478.desc: A Cyborg Digimon that yearns for speed. Dust clouds over barren plains are often caused by Machmon racing noisily. Despite its motorcycle-like appearance, it doesn't have a seat, and no one wants to ride it. However, it believes that it will eventually find a Digimon destined to ride it skillfully. It is a natural-born bosozoku who views anyone that travels at high speed as an enemy.

479.name: LoaderLeomon
479.desc: A Machine Digimon born when the CAD data of construction machinery leaked onto a server and fused with Beast Digimon configuration data. LoaderLeomon's mane is a pneumatic drill, and it operates primarily in tunnel construction and Chrondigizoit mining. In addition to its power and stamina, LoaderLeomon also boasts top-class abilities for a Machine Digimon. Many LoaderLeomon have stubborn personalities and take pride in their work, but people often assume they're just hotheads.

482.name: Ryudamon
482.desc: A Beast Digimon presumed to be an experimental “Prototype Digimon” from before Digimon were discovered due to the antiquated interface on its forehead. Ryudamon is covered in Japanese-style armor that boasts a high defense, yet its movements are quite nimble, allowing it to attack by jumping boldly right into the enemy's chest. The more it fights, the more it cultivates its combat skills.

483.name: Ginryumon
483.desc: A Beast Dragon Digimon with sturdy Japanese-style armor covering its whole body. Ginryumon is lighter than it appears, drifting gracefully through the air and fighting while parrying enemy attacks with its smooth and extremely tough armor. It has the courage to fend off enemy attacks with its own body, and the insight to perceive said attacks right before they land. It is presumed to be an experimental “Prototype Digimon” Digivolution due to the antiquated interface on its forehead.

484.name: Hisyaryumon
484.desc: A Beast Dragon Digimon that soars freely through the skies, clad in armor of elegantly shimmering scales. Its form is the result of the interface on its forehead unlocking the data of dragons and generals from Japanese myths lying dormant deep within its DigiCore. Normally it's possessed of the wisdom and composure of a god, but if either of the orbs it holds it holds is damaged, it will instead grow as fierce as a raging demon, and attack with all the power it can muster.

485.name: Ouryumon
485.desc: An imaginary Digimon born from the daydream of a DigiCore. Its form is the result of Digivolution caused by the interface on its forehead miraculously unlocking the creativity of its own DigiCore. Perhaps because this Digimon's DigiCore already contained data on Japanese myths of fierce dragons and generals, the form that this DigiCore imagined was a dragon warrior clad in imposing Japanese-style armor and wielding a sword in each hand.

487.name: Hookmon
487.desc: A variation of Hookmon that was born after years and years of disillusionment for not capturing the mythical White Whamon. It became stronger to finally achieve its goal, even if it is Impossible.

488.name: Jesmon
488.desc: It is said that this particular Jesmon is proof of the skills of a tamer, as this species is only achieved after extreme battles that requires the maximum of both partners.

489.name: Alphamon: Ouryuken
489.desc: A form Alphamon took on after it miraculously Digivolved Ouryumon into a sword known as the Ouryuken. Ouryumon is the Mega form of the Prototype Digimon that were used in an experiment to reach greater heights of power. Having been transformed into a sword, all of its combat ability is now channeled exclusively into offensive power. To swing the Ouryuken is to wield all the power of a Mega Digimon. The average Digimon would no more be able to use it than to survive an attack from it.

496.name: Marsmon
496.desc: A member of the enigmatic ''Olympos XII'', it is a Digimon god of war with the appearance of a panther-man. Marsmon is well-versed in all sorts of combat techniques known throughout the world, including underhanded techniques, and has absolute confidence in battles against others in the same weight class.

497.name: Asuramon
497.desc: A legendary Digimon which possesses four arms and three faces, it suddenly appeared within a computer as it was analyzing ancient Hindu cultural documents. Of Asuramon's three faces, one is a face of wrath, one is a face of mercy, and the last is a face of blessings. Contrary to its outer appearance, it honors justice, so it is said that if it sees injustice it will thoroughly attack it without yielding, and it can certainly be said that its personality is like an avatar of a god of light.

509.name: MarinAngemon
509.desc: A rarely-sighted Fairy Digimon that inhabits the Net Ocean. Although it possesses the name ''Angemon'', biologically, it is actually of a completely different family from the Angemon-species. The ring worn around Marin Angemon's neck is called a Holy Ring, and it is thought that there is some sort of connection between the ring and holy Digimon as Digimon such as Tailmon or Angewomon have been observed wearing the ring.

514.name: Shoutmon
514.desc: A ferocious Digimon with extremely high aggressiveness due to its hot-blooded enthusiasm. However, it is friendly towards its comrades, and its friendship with other Digimon, surpassing species, can be deepened even further if they are recognized by Shoutmon.

515.name: Shoutmon B
515.desc: A ferocious Small Dragon-type Digimon with high bloodlust and aggression. It is often seen at night, singing lullabies in a rocking style, seemingly every night. It has been seen performing live for sleepless Digimon.

516.name: Shoutmon (Blue)
516.desc: A ferocious Small Dragon-type Digimon with extremely high aggressiveness due to its hot-blooded enthusiasm. Because passion is the very source of its attacks, it will definitely inflict damage no matter the target. It won't give up fighting unless its passion disappears. It is uncertain how or why it developed this blue coloration.

517.name: Shoutmon (Yellow)
517.desc: A strange yellow variant of the ferocious Digimon known as Shoutmon. There is a unique feature to Shoutmon's singing that converts its passion to energy, and it can perform an attack called Soul Crusher, which uses its mic to amplify the heated emotions blazing within its chest, then bash the opponent. The reason why it developed this golden coloration is unknown.

518.name: Mervamon
518.desc: A Deity Digimon and member of the Olympos XII. Mervamon is the form of Minervamon that has amassed experience and achievements over time, and it has a much calmer and more mature personality compared to its previous form. It has come to pursue elegance and charm - observed in abundance in both its mannerisms and conduct - and exudes sensuality into its surroundings. It even seeks charm in battle, showing refined, graceful dancing to fascinate those who witness it.

521.name: Jupitermon
521.desc: A member of the Olympos XII, governing thunder and weather as a god presiding over the heavens. Jupitermon always judges good and evil on the battlefield, delivering divine punishment to the wicked. Such judgment is handed down indifferently, without emotion. Those who disagree with Jupitermon's judgment can challenge it and overturn said judgment upon victory, but as of now, no one has ever accomplished this feat.

524.name: Aegiomon
524.desc: A Deity Digimon with the upper body of a human and the lower body of a mountain goat. Aegiomon is usually affiliated with the same musical troupe as Sirenmon, playing the Syrinx flute hanging on its waist and enjoying music. It loves peace and dislikes fighting, but an unknown quantity of power dwells within, and it demonstrates exceptional combat prowess when fighting to protect something.

525.name: Aegiochusmon
525.desc: A Deity Digimon that synthesized the abilities of various species, using a human body as its base. This synthesis of species is said to have resulted from the pursuit of the apex known as omnipotence, and Aegiochusmon's form changes dramatically to match its environment. This form is based on the data of Dragon-species. Normally this data would lie dormant in this Digimon, centered around the crystal in its chest, but Aegiochusmon has manifested the Dragon data around its body, turning it into an armor.

526.name: Titamon
526.desc: The counterattack titan, born from the grudge of a Digimon felled by the Olympos XII in a contest for supremacy over the Digital World. Also going by the alias the ''One-Man Division'', it harbors bottomless grudge energy within its body, and runs through battlefields looking for the heads of the Olympos XII. Titamon's Zanjintou is a gigantic sword carved from the bones of SkullGreymon, and the ill will confined within the blade emits a low groan.

527.name: Parrotmon
527.desc: A Giant Bird Digimon shaped like a parrot. A strange, mysterious bird that wandered from another Digital World through a rift in space-time, the talons on its feet possess mighty power. As it is very highly intelligent and calm, it prefers not to battle, but once it is angered, it gets out of control.

528.name: Plutomon
528.desc: A Digimon that rules over the realm of the dead and uses fear and violence to terrorize evil. Plutomon, shrouded in deep shadow, stalks through the land in search of villains and criminals who deserve to be sent to the realm of the dead. Plutomon delights in chewing up evildoers with its mouths filled with rows of sharp fangs, and lets out a sinister chattering noise as it seeks out its prey. The combination of this and its fearsome appearance frightens even good Digimon.

531.name: Minotaurmon
531.desc: A dark Digimon that possesses strong Dark Side Power. Although its movements are not swift, it has extremely firm skin, so it won't yield to ordinary attacks. It is able to generate a massive earthquakes with the Demon Arm on its left hand. This attack can floor opponents over a considerably wide range, so that no matter how far away they are they won't be able to escape.

534.name: Merukimon
534.desc: One of the Olympos XII, this Digimon is a genius god boasting the greatest speed in the Digital World. Merukimon's outstanding speed cannot be seen by the naked eye, and any videos recorded of it are said to be of its afterimages. It hates standing still, and is always wandering the Digital World, making it a difficult creature to encounter.

535.name: Hippogriffomon
535.desc: A mythical beast Digimon which has the appearance of a chimera. It is said it will become a Griffomon if it evolves, but the details are not clear. Its intelligence is not as high as Griffomon's, and since its being is closer to that of a beast, its personality is also ferocious.

536.name: Venusmon
536.desc: One of the ''Olympos XII'', it is a Digimon that is filled with compassion and rules over love. Wherever Venusmon is, beautiful flowers bloom profusely no matter how ruined the soil is, and the land's youthful vigor is revived. It is said that there are many Digimon who serve the pure and beautiful Venusmon. Venusmon can correctly perceive the world with its mind's eye by blindfolding itself, and it isn't taken in by any lie or deception

539.name: PlatinumNumemon
539.desc: An exceedingly rare Numemon that evolved by being among the first in the Digital World to discover the ''Platina Mine'', and absorbing the deposits found within. Since then, its personality has undergone a complete change, leading it to gather any and all jewellery it can find and using them to decorate itself, as if it had suddenly struck it rich. It is an extremely ''gorgeous Digimon'', regardless of its appearance.

541.name: BeelStarmon
541.desc: Its cherished twin pistols, the ''Rizoma de Loto'', are like little sisters to the ''Berenjena'' possessed by Beelzebumon. It opens up to everybody without hesitation, and in particular, it is close friends with many gun-wielding Digimon, and has been given the nickname ''Beelko'' by Magna Kidmon and the like. However, it is at loggerheads with the solitary Beelzebumon, so although it recognizes its competence, it keeps a slight distance.

544.name: Death-X-mon
544.desc: This program lacks a DigiCore, and thus cannot be classified as a Digimon. Death-X-mon executes Process 0 through Process F for eternity: detecting DigiCores, taking them into its body to dismantle them, and disposing of them so they can never be reconstructed. Despite being a simple program, conjecture states that defeating it is outside the realm of possibility. Death-X-mon stops functioning in the absence of DigiCores, but said functions cannot be halted as long as DigiCores exist.

545.name: OmegaShoutmon
545.desc: OmegaShoutmon is a form obtained when Omegamon bestowed the legendary ''Evolution'' upon a Shoutmon that released its boiling hot soul. In addition to its intense passion, it shines gold because its whole body is clad in the Omega inForce, a power received from Omegamon, and its build has also become crisp and sharp. Because of its body's glitter and sharpness, its enemies only see Omega Shoutmon's figure as an afterimage that cannot be pursued.

546.name: Deckerdramon
546.desc: Deckerdramon can be said to be a natural enemy of all Flying Digimon. Its low height makes it hard to detect from high altitudes. Combining that with the terrifying ''Deckerdra-Launcher'' equipped on its back, it conceals the ability to shoot down any kind of Flying Digimon with a variety of anti-aircraft missiles. Its aircraft kill-rate swells particularly while it is in terrain filled with obstacles, where it is difficult to discern the source of its attacks.

547.name: MailBirdramon
547.desc: A Raptor-type Flying Digimon. It performs reconnaissance on the status of the battle from the sky, and specializes in performing air support strikes that inflict precise amounts of damage to the opponent using hit-and-run tactics. Its movements are lightning-fast and its vision, eagle-eyed. Because it is always analyzing the status of the battle from the sky and acting accordingly, its personality is calm and calculating, and it excels at making judgments.

548.name: MetalGreymon
548.desc: The ''Tactical-enhancement Mode'', which possesses MailBirdramon's armor on top of Greymon's power, is a form that was strengthened without hindering the fighting strength of Greymon, who specialized in close-combat fighting.

549.name: DeckerGreymon
549.desc: An Assault Strike Mode that adds Deckerdramon's offensive abilities and forward charging capacity to MetalGreymon's power. DeckerGreymon's overall combat ability is equal to that of an entire battalion composed of 324 combat Digimon. Even should it be ambushed by a group of enemies, its rock-solid defense and immense firepower together with its ability to easily maneuver through even the roughest terrain allow it to assault and overrun the enemy line.

556.name: DORUgoramon
556.desc: An imaginary Digimon born from the daydream of a DigiCore. Its form is the result of Digivolution caused by the interface on its forehead miraculously unlocking the creativity of its own DigiCore. This form created by the DigiCore is an avatar of powerful destruction and the incarnation of the ''Ultimate Enemy'', perhaps due to the powerful draconic data sleeping deep within said DigiCore.

557.name: Omegamon Zwart Defeat
557.desc: The form of Omegamon Zwart transformed into a berserker when someone infected it with a virus program. Any Digimon that crosses its path is viewed as a sinister foe, and any who get close will face a merciless onslaught. The clash between the raging virus program and the remnant vaccine program inside its body has made it unstable, causing it to cycle between exhaustion and rampage while unable to heal its wounds.

559.name: GigaSeadramon
559.desc: After the success of MetalSeadramon, which boasts the fastest underwater movement speed and the most powerful interception abilities possible, the Crack Team decided to develop GigaSeadramon. GigaSeadramon possesses a cruising speed that allows it to cover a vast expanse of the Net Ocean, the result of an attempt to further expand the Crack Team's area of operations. It is a massive Digimon with the power to rule the seas developed in utmost secrecy.

561.name: Mastemon
561.desc: An Angel Digimon said to appear when a crisis with no precedents descends upon the Digital World, coming into being through the inharmonious pairing of an Angel and a Dark Angel Digimon in Jogress Evolution. It faces this predicament by controlling the might of both angel and dark angel clans summoned through gates from another Digital World. Mastemon accomplishes this through a temperament that has earned it the moniker of the ''Tactician from Another World'', allowing these normally hostile factions to work together.

563.name: Paledramon
563.desc: A Digimon that Digivolved from Blucomon. Paledramon's large, icy wings allow it to fly quickly even in bad weather. Its body is no longer affected by changes in temperature based on the environment, but when facing fiery Digimon like Meramon, Paledramon's icy form will melt just like when it was a Rookie, leaving it weakened. Paledramon is always thinking of its friends, and if one of its companion Digimon is in trouble, it will do whatever it can to help them, regardless of the risk.

567.name: Tinkermon
567.desc: A Fairy Digimon that is always snuggling up to Petermon. It bounces around in the best of moods when it is with Petermon, but if it's ignored then it will angrily strike Petermon and then fly off somewhere. After that, it is happy to come looking for Petermon and meekly receive pampering. Tinkermon's wings shine, and because there is a change in the strength of the radiance when it is tense, looking at the wings' radiance is considered a good way to suss out Tinkermon's mood.

568.name: ClearAgumon
568.desc: A subspecies of ToyAgumon whose whole body is made up of unique, clear plastic blocks. It is a very rare Digimon, and is said to have been created by a child just like ToyAgumon, but is difficult to find, and it has been estimated that the likelihood of doing so is one thousandth that of ToyAgumon. Its personality is just like ToyAgumon's, and despite being cowardly, it possesses a heart of justice that cannot turn a blind eye to evil.

569.name: ToyAgumon (Black)
569.desc: A form of ToyAgumon, who possesses a righteous heart that doesn't condone evil, that was infected by a computer virus and has been dyed black. Unlike ToyAgumon, it loves to bully children, however its cowardice hasn't been cured, and its blocks fall apart into pieces when it's surprised.

570.name: Kudamon
570.desc: A Holy Beast Digimon that is always wreathed around a holy cartridge and never separates from it. It is said that day after day, it accumulates holy power within the earring on its left ear, and that the stored power is great enough to have influence on its next evolution. It has a calm, cool, and collected personality, conducting a precise assessment of the situation even in combat, and attaining the advantage in battle.

571.name: Dracumon
571.desc: The Dark Area's most mischievous Digimon. For the sake of a prank, it will meet the challenge unflinchingly even if it is accompanied by some risk. It once nearly got itself killed trying to graffiti the faces of all four of the Four Holy Beasts...(it's unknown whether it succeeded). It was once a bloodsucking Digimon, but these days it forgets to suck blood, and it seems it's trying to play some kind of trick on the Royal Knights.

572.name: Kotemon
572.desc: A Reptile Digimon aiming to become a top-class swordsman amongst Digimon. Despite being untalkative, it is hardworking and diligently undergoes training behind the scenes. Its true appearance is a mystery, as it never removes its defensive gear. Although it has a timid personality and cries easily, it cares deeply for its friends and has a strong sense of justice, also showing its strong-willed side from time to time.

573.name: Dinohumon
573.desc: A Dragon Man Digimon with the appearance of a humanoid lizard. It lives in an area that has not yet become a modernised civilisation, where all of the tribesmen are valiant combat dragons who possess the makings of a warrior. It has great muscle strength, allowing its to swing its greatsword, Akinakes, with ease.

575.name: Agunimon
575.desc: A Digimon that possesses power over Flame which bears the might of one of the Ten Legendary Warriors. Because its Digicore is wrapped in the Spiritual Fire which is called a holy blaze, it is able to freely manipulate flames. It is an incarnation of the ''Firewall'' that defends the Net, and is also a guardian deity. Because of its easily fired-up personality, it has a soldier-like aspect that practices mental training with yoga exercises, and its way of speaking is somewhat archaic, like a kenpo artist.

576.name: BurningGreymon
576.desc: A Digimon that possesses power over Flame which bears the might of one of the Ten Legendary Warriors. This firefighter has skin that can withstand high temperatures and the ability to move even through lava, and snuffs out flames with instant, explosive blazes. It is said that it was born from active volcano research data, and it is thought that it contains an immeasurable, unknown energy.

577.name: Lobomon
577.desc: A Digimon that possesses power over Light which bears the might of one of the Ten Legendary Warriors. The lavender parts all over its body are Saint Amethyst, in which holy light is contained. Due to the holy light, the amethyst retains its extraordinary hardness as long as it keeps its righteous spirit, but the second a negative spirit arises in the possessor, it becomes brittle. It is the possessor of a chivalrous spirit that puts its life on the line for the things it believes in, and hates injustice.

578.name: KendoGarurumon
578.desc: A Digimon that possesses power over Light which bears the might of one of the Ten Legendary Warriors. It is capable of moving at extremely high speed, perhaps because it was discovered on an optical communication Net, so it slips through the bullets to get close to the enemy, and then its sharply-pointed claws and fangs tear through those it considers evil without wasting its breath.

579.name: Drimogemon
579.desc: A Digimon that moves underground at high speeds with the gigantic drill attached to its snout. It is an extremely rare Digimon to come across because it is always digging deep underground. Although it has a meek, shy personality, it is fairly mischievous, and sometimes it takes the favorite bones that Garurumon has buried underground and hides them in different locations.

580.name: Beetlemon
580.desc: A Digimon that possesses power over Thunder which bears the might of one of the Ten Legendary Warriors. Its keen movements, unbecoming of its large build, are a technique to form a high voltage current running throughout its body. It generates a special magnetic field that produces an anti-gravity state in its vicinity, and is capable of high-speed movement. Its overflowing thunder power comes out as sparks from various parts of its body.

581.name: MetalKabuterimon
581.desc: A Digimon that possesses power over Thunder which bears the might of one of the Ten Legendary Warriors. It has a cautious and prudent personality because it was discovered in a defense system created in reference to the Scarab treasure chamber in the deepest part of a pyramid. During battle, it patiently serves as a shield for its comrades using its sturdy armor and endures the opponent's attacks, but if it reaches its critical point it will go on an intense offensive with all of its gunports.

585.name: NiseDrimogemon
585.desc: As a Digimon just like Drimogemon, it was given the name ''Nise'' due to its suspicious mustache. If this Digimon were to have been discovered earlier, Drimogemon could have ended up being called ''Nise''.

586.name: Snimon
586.desc: An experimental Digimon that was created at a research facility as a Virus Hunter. Due to its unfeeling personality, it is feared by both Vaccine and Data-attribute Digimon. The sickles on both of its arms are honed to their sharpest, allowing it to cleanly slice through anything. Although Snimon is a Digimon that has no eyes, the red antennae growing from its head have become sensors, and are able to accurately pinpoint the target's location.

588.name: Musyamon
588.desc: Originally, it was the data of a samurai master from an overseas video game, but it was infected by a computer virus, and evolved to become this armored warrior Digimon. Its countless battles with Digimon have reduced it to its current appearance of a ruthless ochimusha, but this can also be said to be proof of this Digimon's terrifying combat ability and vitality. Musyamon is the very image of a savage warrior who continues to live through its endless battles.

589.name: Oboromon
589.desc: An Undead Digimon that lives in graveyards like a ghost, it is a berserker who never backs down against superior opponents and fights by any means necessary. It is thought that the reason it has an unusually intense obsession with victory is because it has taken in a large amount of hatred data from the Digimon it has defeated. On the other hand, it has virtually no sense of self, and when it isn't fighting, it wanders around the graveyard foolishly.

590.name: Zanbamon
590.desc: A Demon Man Digimon which has the appearance of a horse-riding warrior. It is a courageous warrior who reigns as the general of the Musyamon corps. Although it is a general, it voluntarily stands at the head of its own army, and prefers fighting styles which cut into the enemy. Its lower half is fused with its horse in order to move more easily about the battlefield, so that even during a pitched battle it is able to swing its sword without losing its balance.

591.name: Tactimon
591.desc: A soldier Digimon that possesses a peerless sword called ''Jatetsufujin-maru''. Within this sword is sealed a sinister power strong enough to split a star in two, so drawing it marks the collapse of a star. Therefore, Tactimon battles without drawing it, but even so, it exhibits the destructive force of its menace. Even more than its merit as a soldier, Tactimon excels in strategy with plans which are even said to be, ''ingenuity itself'', so Tactimon's true merit is not in physical strength but in ingenuity.

592.name: Vorvomon
592.desc: A Digimon made of a solid, hot ore. It has wings on both of its arms and is able to fly for up to a few seconds, but gets tired easily. It is very passionate, so the more excited it gets, the hotter its horns and claws will become.

593.name: Pomumon
593.desc: Although it looks like a Bird-type, it is a Plant Digimon whose body is packed with juices with high sugar content like that of a fruit. For that reason, it has many natural predators such as Bird and Insect Digimon. Despite having wings, it is mainly active on land because its flight speed is so slow that it becomes defenseless.

594.name: Kamemon
594.desc: A turtle-like Cyborg Digimon with a carapace similar to a computer mouse. It doesn't talk much in front of other people and can conceal its entire body in its armored hide, however its helmet remains exposed.

595.name: Ganimon
595.desc: A Crustacean Digimon that stuck the metal data dissolved in the Net Ocean to its body, rapidly enhancing its combat ability. It attacks with the gigantic blade on its left foreleg and the grip of its strong right foreleg and defends with the spine-covered shell that covers itself, inflicting damage to attacking opponents, so it's a confident person with substantial self-confidence in battle. Its weak points are its joint parts and its belly, but because it's also aware of that, it never shows that chink in its armor.

596.name: Flamon
596.desc: A Digimon that was transformed into a half-beast, half-man form when Agnimon lost its power. It is missing the ''Combat Instinct'' that Digimon naturally possess, and moreover, it has lost power. However, it is a being that has inherited a Spirit of the Ten Legendary Warriors who possess ultimate strength, so although it has lost power, ordinary Adult-class Digimon aren't a match for it. If anything, it has kindness inappropriate for a Digimon and is similar to a Child Digimon, counterbalancing its mischievous part.

597.name: Dinotigermon
597.desc: It is an Ancient Beast Digimon which took in the metal elements of the earth, super-hardened its whole body, and evolved from one of the few SaberLeomon which have repeated and survived endless battles. Its movements are not swift compared to SaberLeomon, but it possesses almost twice as much tough flesh and physical strength, and with its big, sharp, sword-like fangs, it forcibly brings down even Digimon larger than itself and which possess thick skin or armor.

598.name: Muchomon
598.desc: A Bird Digimon that is unable to fly, just like Penmon. As a Digimon brought up in tropical southern countries, it leads an always happy life. It possesses a bursting enthusiasm and dances with the rhythm of the samba, and its most favorite thing is its richly colored pelt.

599.name: Lalamon
599.desc: A Plant Digimon which has an appearance like a flower bud. Spinning the leaf on its head lets it float along. It lacks expression but still maintains its charm.

600.name: Sunflowmon
600.desc: A Plant Digimon which has an appearance like the sunflower. If it bathes in the sun's light it becomes very energetic, and even its offensive power rises. On days when the weather is good it will also flap the leaves on its back to fly around.

601.name: Lilamon
601.desc: A Fairy Digimon which has an appearance like the lilac, a flower that is loved by everyone. It is pure and innocent, and despite its beautiful appearance, it is said to govern over death and rebirth. Its leaves are toxic, and are enough to bring death to the opponent.

605.name: Chikurimon
605.desc: A Digimon that lurks either underwater or in the shade of large rocks, hardly ever moving from its chosen location. Although it is naturally inclined to attack anyone who draws near, it's not actually an aggressive Digimon, and will refrain from attacking so long as it's not approached. However, since the Chikurimon population explodes at warm temperatures, they can overrun lakes and rocky areas in the summer. This often leads to other Digimon being attacked as they try to get a drink of water.

607.name: Pidmon
607.desc: An Angel Digimon with two wings, whose body is clad in shining white cloth. Although it is a being of perfected virtue like Angemon, its rank is below Angemon's. However, its power is on par with Angemon, and it is a being that destroys evil, wielding its Holy Rod.

614.name: Nanimon
614.desc: An unidentified Digimon that invaded from an other-dimensional Digital World. Nanimon went by the nickname of ''Oyaji'' in the other dimension, and was kept as a digital pet. It loves alcohol and violence, but once it invaded this Digital World (the details of which are still fuzzy), it Digivolved into an active creature. Inspired by the survival-of-the-fittest nature of the Digital World, it threw itself into battle. Its true power remains unknown.

618.name: Angewomon
618.desc: An Archangel Digimon that inhabits a region where ''Dusk'' and ''Dawn'' are in constant conflict. There's virtually no physical difference between this Angewomon and the one in pink besides its colors, even having the same number of wings. It is believed that this probable subspecies of Angewomon dislikes Puppet Digimon.

621.name: Whamon
621.desc: The Whamon on Folder Continent are Ultimate-level Digimon that surpassed the Champion-level Whamon of File Island in both offensive ability and vitality. Although this subspecies is considered a Champion-level Digimon, its vitality can be compared to the ones in Folder Continent. This Whamon was spotted at least once in the Human World, but normally it lives at the seabed of ​​another server in the Digital World.

622.name: MasterTyranomon
622.desc: An ancient type of Dinosaur Digimon that evolved from top-class Tyranomon in ancient times. It takes on a master-like role, coaching its Tyranomon followers and raising them to become full-fledged warriors. It is said that this type of MasterTyranomon inhabits a humid area on the eastern portion of File Island, known as ''Ancient Dino Region''.

623.name: HerculesKabuterimon
623.desc: A gigantic Insect Digimon with a golden armor. Due to the soft parts exposed on the belly and legs, this HerculesKabuterimon is estimated to be a young specimen. This theory is also supported by the less durable and shiny armor, and less damaged wings. However, nothing has been concluded yet, and it's still unclear if this is a separated species or not.

624.name: Ganimon
624.desc: A Crustacean Digimon that migrated from the Net Ocean to a more tropical region. This subspecies first appeared when a Ganimon moved to warmer environments changing its color due to the heat. It is believed that there are more colors of Ganimon in other environments.

625.name: Snimon
625.desc: This subspecies of Snimon was created in the same research facility that created the original one in order to study the ability of camouflage. Unlike Snimon, which targets down prey as a precise machine, this subspecies only attacks when provoked.

626.name: Woodmon
626.desc: An elusive Plant Digimon with the appearance of a large, lush tree trunk. As a result of countless hours spent immobile disguising itself as an ordinary tree, several lichen developed across the whole body of this Digimon, giving the green coloration it now has. It is said that because of that, Woodmon was able to become is even stronger.

627.name: Minotaurmon
627.desc: It is believed that this subspecies of Minotaurmon's Demon Arm has Gold Digizoid in it but it is impossible to verify this because of this Digimon's violent behavior. Although the Gold Digizoid boosts absolute defense, even reflecting attacks, with its brutal behavior it was never seen using it for defense, only attack.

628.name: LadyDevimon
628.desc: This mysterious subspecies of LadyDevimon is only seen leading a horde of irrational LadyDevimon attacking everything in sight. Usually LadyDevimon doesn't have regeneration abilities, but under the leadership of this subspecies, they can regenerate multiple times.

629.name: Brachiomon
629.desc: A towering Digimon that existed long ago. Researchers believe that a Brachiomon who bears this gray coloration is an older individual, who witnessed various generations of Digimon evolve. It is said that in the past, when hackers illegitimately got access to this Digimon, it was discovered that it had the ability to learn fire based moves.

631.name: Pickmon
631.desc: Pickmon are part of the Starmons corps, making up most of its members. There is a strict hierarchy within each unit, and orders from higher-ranking members must be followed with perfect obedience. As a result, many Pickmon give up on ever becoming a Starmon, dropping out to return to the wild. However, some Pickmon persevere, aiming for independence as they leave the group. These are promoted to become Majors and succeed in becoming Starmon.

632.name: Wormmon
632.desc: A Larva Digimon with a bright, vivid blue coloration. Unlike regular Wormmon, which is powerless by nature, this subspecies seems to possess a natural ''battle spirit'', being able to fight without relying on the power of Armor Evolution which it seems to lack.

633.name: Rafflesimon
633.desc: When trying to avoid its short life-span, Rafflesiamon became infect by a mysterious virus know as GRB when in contact with a certain jet black Dragon Digimon. Thanks to this infection it lost its temper and will to dance, becoming a frenzied Digimon.

634.name: Kazemon
634.desc: A Digimon that possesses power over Wind which bears the might of one of the Ten Legendary Warriors. It freely manipulates the atmosphere to display mirages to its opponents, and specializes in attacks that generate ''Kamaitachi'' made from vacuums. However, it is more proficient in information warfare than in actual combat ability. Although it has an innocent personality brimming with curiosity, and is a gossipy, talkative troublemaker, because it has no ill will for the person, it isn't really hated.

635.name: Chackmon
635.desc: A Digimon that possesses power over Ice which bears the might of one of the legendary Warrior Ten. It styles itself as holding rank as a member of a polar army's polar region defense force. Since it replies that the matter's top secret if you ask anything about it, the truth is unknown. It's thought to be largely something it dreamed up. However, its operation of the Launcher it carries and its precision conduct in battle are genuine, and its survivalist knowledge also has a strong, truly reliable existence.

636.name: Zephyrmon
636.desc: A Digimon that possesses power over Wind which bears the might of one of the Ten Legendary Warriors. At a glance, it looks like a composed adult woman, but although it perplexes its opponents with its languid behavior, it actually has an impish personality that loves to capriciously embarrass people. It does things like purposefully telling its opponent unhappy fortunes or startling them.

637.name: Korikakumon
637.desc: A Digimon that possesses power over Ice which bears the might of one of the Ten Legendary Warriors. It's closer to recklessness than dauntless courage, but in any case it's a ruffian overflowing with desire and ambition. It's powerfully curious and a show-off, so it's pretty frivolous. On the brink of battle, it always pauses to offer a prayer to the god of ice and snow in which it believes, then shouts the names of its Special Moves and something humorous.

638.name: Drimogemon
638.desc: Despite its unique coloration, this subspecies lacks distinctive traits to set it apart from a regular Drimogemon. Because of that, unlike NiseDrimogemon which has its own name, this one is yet to be named. It has been observed that it is slightly stronger than both Drimogemon and NiseDrimogemon.

639.name: Beetlemon
639.desc: A Digimon that possesses power over Thunder, however it's correlation to the Ten Legendary Warriors is uncertain. It is speculated that the high voltage current running throughout the body of this Digimon is heavily influenced by the North magnetic field, hence why it bears a bright red shell instead of the regular blue one.

640.name: Agunimon
640.desc: A Digimon that possesses power over Flame, however it's correlation to the Ten Legendary Warriors is uncertain. It is said that this Agunimon is also a guardian deity, acting when the Digimon known as the incarnation of the ''Firewall'' that defends the Net is not available for duty.

641.name: Renamon
641.desc: A Beast Man Digimon with the appearance of a silver fox that looks like the subspecies of Kyubimon whose fur is silver. Depending on how Pokomon is raised it can evolve into a Renamon with more or less intelligence and compared to the one with golden fur this one is less intelligent, although it has excellent speed.

643.name: Pukumon
643.desc: A Punk Digimon that was created by a hacker when an infamous British prime minister passed away in the last decade. It seems like this Pukumon subspecies acquired aspects of said prime minister, however it seems to fight for oposite causes. As a side effect of this incompatibility, its color changed and it turned slighty more powerful.

644.name: Dinomon
644.desc: Dinomon is the pinnacle of a long-embattled Dinosaur Digimon. This Mega Digimon has awakened an ancient power, visible through the glow of its body. Dinomon boasts incredible stamina and strength, overwhelming its enemy with its power. As the battle heats up, the black scales covering its body turn a flaming red, and Dinomon is able to use the energy within to attack more efficiently. It is said that when Dinomon pulls out all the stops in a fight, the entire area will be reduced to ash and magma.

645.name: Gokimon
645.desc: Roachmon has the shiny black body of that most widely reviled of pests—the cockroach. Ever careful to stay out of sight, it moves around quite nimbly, although it goes even faster when running away. Despite having only lackluster offensive and defensive abilities, its boundless drive to live lets it really shine in an endurance match.

647.name: Betsumon
647.desc: An eccentric Digimon that impersonates all sorts of Digimon in order to confuse the enemy. While it is a Puppet Digimon, similarly to Etemon and Monzaemon, it is a rare type capable of disguising itself as various types of Digimon by changing the Digimon Suit(?) it wears.

648.name: Fujinmon
648.desc: A Cyborg Digimon bestowed with the name of the Fūjin of Oriental folklore. As a Light Fighter that battles with light movements, it specializes in close combat. Its Signature Move is cutting the enemy to pieces with the same cutter-type arm as Justimon.

649.name: Suijinmon
649.desc: A Machine Digimon that parts oceans and smashing cliffs, known as the ''Ultimate Commander of Waterfalls''. It possesses parts from both Justimon and Mugendramon. While the reason why these parts are being used is unknown, there is no doubt that it has great combat strength.

650.name: Raijinmon
650.desc: An Android Digimon that gets its name from a god of thunder in Japanese folklore. Cleaving clouds and wearing lightning, this Digimon is known as ''The Ultimate Commander of Thunderclaps''. Raijinmon is the kind of fighter that excels in close-quarters combat.

651.name: Raidenmon
651.desc: A heavyweight Machine Digimon equipped with electromagnetic weapons. Unlike Raijinmon, a Digimon that similarly uses electricity to power its attacks, Raidenmon was constructed to be a ranged fighter. Though not very skilled at fighting in close quarters, it is protected by thick armor, and can counterattack with the weapon in its left arm.

652.name: NeoDevimon
652.desc: NeoDevimon is a Digivolution of Devimon created when an unknown individual enhanced Devimon's abilities. As a result of this process, even NeoDevimon's own will is subject to the complete control of another, making it a fully artificial Digimon. The mask that covers its face is used to regulate its powers, and is said to have been placed there to rob NeoDevimon of its own volition.

653.name: Gaioumon
653.desc: A subspecies of Greymon, which is an excellent combat species in its own right, Gaiomon is a Dragon Man Digimon that has grown in strength through victory in battle. Found in an abandoned computer in the East, much of its strength has yet to be quantified, but it clearly has an unbelievable amount of combat experience earned through countless battles. It was in the course of all those battles that it also gained its uniquely shaped swords, the Kikurin.

654.name: Dogmon
654.desc: A Puppet Digimon born from a database of American cartoons. Dogmon's body is both fluffy and durable, and can expand and contract like rubber to absorb any and all attacks. Though its appearance gives the impression that it is extremely dangerous, this Digimon is the definition of harmlessness, lacking any ill will or aggression.

655.name: Ukkomon
655.desc: A mythical Ancient Species Digimon whose activity records remain in the ancient Digital World. Rumor has it that Ukkomon can grant the wishes of others, and it is said that because of this, many Digimon gathered around Ukkomon and flourished, forming villages. However, records of Ukkomon's activities were lost with the destruction of the ancient Digital World, and it is thought that it had become extinct.

656.name: Petermon
656.desc: A Digimon resembling a boy dancing freely across the sky. Petermon entices young Digimon who refuse to Digivolve with a promise to build a land only for kids, then invites them to Never-Ever Land, a world it built itself. Its personality seems innocent and naive, but underneath that purity lurks a certain degree of brutality. Petermon is particularly harsh toward Digimon who break promises, beating them down in a ''punishment game''.

657.name: DoneDevimon
657.desc: A Digimon that reached the Mega level by taking in as much negative data as possible. Its mental state lies somewhere between madness and sanity, but when angered it loses all trace of reason, lashing out like a wild beast. Any Digimon attacked by a rampaging DoneDevimon is utterly annihilated.

658.name: Ranamon
658.desc: A Digimon with power over water that bears the might of the Ten Legendary Warriors. Ranamon has a sharp intuition and changes its feelings easily, perhaps due to the fact that it operates mainly in the ocean area of a weather forecasting system. Its emotions are tempestuous, and it acts like a lovely young lady when it's in a good mood, or cries hysterically like a baby when it gets upset.

659.name: ShinMonzaemon
659.desc: A Puppet Digimon that Digivolved as a result of nightmare-related data absorbed and analyzed by Monzaemon. At first glance, it looks like a teddy bear, but is actually made of a mysterious substance that is both squishy and amorphous. It likes simple and cute things, causing it to target immature Digimon Rookie level and below. On the other hand, ShinMonzaemon considers Digimon that have grown beyond Rookie to be repulsive existences imbued with impure data, and despises even being close to them.

660.name: Ophanimon: Falldown Mode
660.desc: A form of Ophanimon that was so angry that it suppressed its own emotions and fell into madness. It swelled with anger at the world, where atrocious sins keep mounting no matter how many times they are purged, and it closed off its heart. In order to nip evil in the bud, it hunts whichever opponents it has judged to have become a barrier to justice, and tries to establish a world of what it recognizes as justice.

661.name: MadLeomon
661.desc: A berserker that strengthened its combat instinct while sacrificing its intellectual capacity. Once a Lion-species Digimon, MadLeomon modified itself again and again until it became like this. Its consciousness disappeared in this process, transforming it into a puppet that defeats those who stand before it, as commanded. MadLeomon moves by instinct and lacks any thoughts, always charging madly ahead without regard to tricks or traps.

662.name: MadLeomon: Armed Mode
662.desc: The ''Weapon-frenzy Mode'' of a MadLeomon, who gave itself a chainsaw as well as even more modifications. Due to its repeated modifications and unbalanced chainsaw, intense pain is always running through its body, enraging MadLeomon. This pain prevents it from staying in place, causing it to view everything it sees as an enemy and attack.

663.name: Mermaimon
663.desc: A Digimon resembling a mermaid from folklore, taking up residence in the coldest seas of the Digital World. Unlike most Digimon, singing comes easily to Mermaimon, and it offers up a charming tune when the occasion warrants. Due to its avarice and weakness for treasure, it will charm other Digimon before taking the opportunity to plunder their data (treasure). Because of this, there is thought to be a colossal cache of data hidden somewhere in the Net Ocean.

664.name: Fangmon
664.desc: A Dark Beast Digimon that resides deep in the forest, preying on those who get lost within. Fangmon is said to be the Digimon form of big bad wolves that appear in several fairy tales. It allows no prey to escape once it has it in its sights, even disguising itself as a friendly face on occasion to get close to them. It is considered a heretic by other canine Digimon. If Garurumon is a being of light, Fangmon is a being of darkness.

665.name: AncientIrismon
665.desc: One of the Ten Legendary Warriors that saved the Ancient Digital World, possessing the attribute of Wind. A Mega that existed in the far-distant past, AncientIrismon has a beautiful rainbow-colored form and golden wings. It flies swiftly through the vast skies with its golden wings, and can supposedly move freely through earth or water by creating rainbow bridges. The beauty and abilities of AncientKazemon would later be inherited by Bird Man and Pixie Digimon.

666.name: BigUkkomon
666.desc: A Digimon thought to have emerged the very moment that the ancient Digital World was destroyed. It is said to have sacrificed its own life to summon a Digi-Egg from the sadness of the Digimon that disappeared one after another during the great destruction. However, information regarding whether or not this Digimon was able to complete this act does not exist within any records.

667.name: Jyureimon
667.desc: A Digimon of very high intelligence and power. In a certain period of the year, everyone decided to decorate a Jyureimon, and because of that, it transformed into a beautiful Christmas tree!

668.name: SantaAgumon
668.desc: An unique Agumon with a red velvet hat and a jolly demeanor. This variant is said to appear once a year influenced by a western tradition, but the reason for its appearence is still a mistery. Due to its peculiar accent it attaches ''Ho Ho'' to the end of its speech. Santa Agumon strenght is never shown since when it appears it only delivers gifts to Digimons in the Digital World and human kids in the Human World with the help of fast-travelling Digimon.

669.name: Snowballmon
669.desc: A festive Digimon with a snowball-shaped body. Little is known about this Digimon. It appears to originate from data on snowball fights, which are highly associated with winter, but none of this has been confirmed. It is said that this Digimon is associated with a holiday commercial of an old kids channel, however few seem to remember this.

670.name: Snowmanmon
670.desc: A Festive Digimon. Snowmanmon is an archetypal snowman, with a carrot as nose and branches for arms. The information available about this Digimon is dubious, as it is classified as an Undead Digimon related to the so-called ''King of Undead Digimon''. However, it is unclear whether this association is the result of a bug in the ''Digimon Analyzer'' or not. All that is known about this Digimon is its association with a holiday commercial of an old kids channel, however few seem to remember this fact.

671.name: Morphomon
671.desc: A Digimon with hands and ears composed of butterfly wings. Morphomon has a laid-back personality, and feels enjoyment toward nature. When it meets someone for the first time, it touches them to determine whether they're safe or not. If they are, and if it takes a liking to them, Morphomon will go with them. When Morphomon's ear-wings flap vigorously, this is apparently a sign of it being in a great mood.

672.name: Eosmon
672.desc: An artificial Digimon based on a certain other Digimon. While it's been commonly accepted that artificial Digimon peak at Rookie level, extensive research has overturned this assumption, allowing Eosmon to Digivolve to Champion level. It lacks emotion, moving according to the instructions of researchers. Any good or evil deed it performs depends on how a researcher programmed it.

673.name: Eosmon
673.desc: The Digivolved form taken by a Champion Eosmon when it encountered an obstruction while carrying out its mission. Eosmon (Ultimate) deploys even more transparent panels, gaining large wings for high-speed movement, and large hands for powerful attacks. It can also create illusions that act as mirrors to deceive its enemies. Eosmon (Ultimate) can also rearrange its transparent panels to transform into Beast Mode and attack its foes.

674.name: Eosmon
674.desc: The Mega form of Eosmon born when a researcher lost control after things didn't go as expected, fusing multitudes of Eosmon into a single being. Eosmon (Mega) runs amok, following a sole instruction: eliminate all obstacles. New Ultimate Eosmon are produced from its bulging tail, allowing it to increase its subordinates.

677.name: Agumon
677.desc: One of the many existing subspecies of Agumon. This variant seems to possess a natural ''battle spirit'', granting it great fight skills. For some reason, this subspecies of Agumon have a deeper connection with the Royal Knight known as Omegamon. It is uncertain why, but scientists believe that it has to do with how its DigiCore was programmed.

678.name: Agumon
678.desc: One of the many existing subspecies of Agumon. This is one of many Digimon variants that possess a natural ''battle spirit''. This Digimon is said to appear when there is an abundance of other Agumon. Its reddish color helps it stand out, preventing it from being confused with other individuals.

679.name: Agumon
679.desc: One of the many existing Agumon subspecies. This one has a cyan coloration and deep purple eyes. This seems to be a species born only to fight. There are reports of this subspecies facing opponents of much higher levels and holding their own in the fight, even if with some difficulty. It is said that the most skilled were even seen winning such fights against formidable opponents.

680.name: Agumon (Black)
680.desc: Although it is impossible to prove, it is believed that this blue-skinned subspecies evolved from Agumon (Black) rather than the regular Agumon. This hypothesis is based on the aggressive behavior that these individuals present, in addition to the ability to expel greenish flames, just like Agumon (Black).

681.name: PicoDevimon
681.desc: A tiny familiar Digimon which has the appearance of a bat. This purple subspecies is known to be the errand boy of a certain Demon Lord. It serves to report any important news to its master. Because of that, it can constantly be seen carrying a tiny camera on its back.

685.name: Aldamon
685.desc: A Digimon whose power over fire exceeds that of legend due to the unknown powers it obtained by fully inheriting the might of the Ten Legendary Warriors. Aldamon is a Demon God who transforms fear and anger into a righteous power to fight. Its violent behavior earns it many enemies, but its name reflects the fused form of the wildness of a beast with the intelligence of a man. In battle, it unleashes attacks over incredibly large areas, melting and burning everything to a crisp.

686.name: KaiserGreymon
686.desc: A transcendent Digimon with power over flame, said to even surpass the might of the Ten Legendary Warriors. The power of the nine dragon veins flowing through Gaia resides in KaiserGreymon's body. It has been prophesied that if it can harness that power, it will demonstrate unfathomable ability and rule over Gaia. It wields the Ryuugonken, a sword with the souls of dragons sealed within, in order to control this power.

687.name: Gaioumon: Itto Mode
687.desc: The form taken by Gaioumon defeated in battle, obtaining new power after unimaginable training. The ogre data sleeping within its DigiCore has awakened, changing its fighting style to one using a single sword. Having mastered the Tenrin sword style passed down through the eastern Digital World, Gaioumon: Itto Mode specializes in ''silent'' swordplay that cuts down its foes instantly and soundlessly. Once Gaiomon is in its fighting stance, none can approach without putting themselves at risk.

688.name: AeroV-dramon
688.desc: A veteran warrior who evolved with a heart consumed by darkness. Legends say that this blue-black mythical dragon exhibits even greater ferocity than a regular AeroV-dramon, however it's existence is so rare nowadays that its existence is becoming nothing more than a myth.

689.name: Chackmon
689.desc: A Digimon that possesses power over Ice, however it's correlation to the Ten Legendary Warriors is uncertain. It styles itself as holding the Gold rank as a member of a polar army's polar region defense force, which is reinforced by the yellow colors of its uniform. Because of that, it supposedly exerts command over the other Chackmon, however since it always says everything about this matter is classified information, it is likely Chackmon's own fabrication.

690.name: WaruMonzaemon
690.desc: A Puppet Digimon that has been forgotten for a long time. Due to being left aside for too long, its skin has accumulated bacteria and fungi, which have made this Digimon grimy and yellowish. The mysterious eye that once shone within it now seems to have solidified into a green gem. As a result of this forced way of life, this subspecies of WaruMonzaemon has become even more cruel and depressed then its regular counterpart.

691.name: CrysPaledramon
691.desc: A Dragon Man Digimon that only a few Paledramon are said to be capable of Digivolving into. Its icy exterior has developed further, transforming into a kind of armor that covers its entire body. This greatly increases its offensive and defensive capabilities. Thanks to the pillars of ice that extend from its wings, it is now able to maintain its form unchanged, even when facing Digimon that give off incredible heat.

692.name: Hexeblaumon
692.desc: A legendary Magic Knight Digimon that only those who master ice magic are said to be able to Digivolve into. Rumor has it that Hexeblaumon helped protect other Digimon while the Digital World was in the midst of an ice age, then traveled to the extradimensional world of Witchelny. Skilled at techniques that involve manipulating cold, Hexeblaumon can create a variety of things from ice. These range from weapons like swords and hammers to restraints meant to hinder an enemy's movement and even barriers to protect itself.

693.name: OmegaBetsumon*
693.desc: An eccentric Digimon that acquired a still unknow power due to a mysterious form of DigiXros. It's Digimon Suit changed color from a faded white to a shine gold thanks to the Omega InForce, although it can only use it while doing gags. The sharpness from its previous form can be seen not only on its color, but also on the sharp X bandage in its umbilical hernia.##*Speculative name. This Digimon has no known official name.

694.name: Sparrowmon
694.desc: A Digimon specializing in dogfights, soaring soundlessly through the skies at high speeds. Speed is not Sparrowmon's only weapon, however. Its tight turning radius offers the maneuverability necessary to execute sudden turns without effort. Fundamentally moody and excitable, its flight style changes based on its mood. When Sparrowmon performs difficult aerial acrobatics without being asked, this is undeniable proof of its high spirits.

695.name: Damemon
695.desc: It was born when waste data drifting through the Digital World combined randomly. Its favorite phrase is ''No good, no good!'' and it has the unfortunate habit of criticizing everyone around it, regardless of the time or place. Though Damemon is perhaps best described with its own phrase, it somehow manages to get by with the help of its partner Tyutyumon. It's only with Tyutyumon's help that Damemon can even manage to function as a halfway decent Digimon.

696.name: Shoutmon (King)
696.desc: Shoutmon (King) is a gallant form of Shoutmon with a yellow scarf that flutters in the wind. Its strength has increased by leaps and bounds thanks to its training, and it stands out all the more in its performances with its McField-brand microphone.

697.name: MetalShoutmon
697.desc: This unusual Digimon is the result of a DigiXros between a powerful Shoutmon and a MetalTyranomon. MetalShoutmon specializes in the musical style known as Heavy Metal, and its unique feature is the ability to transform its guttural vocals into pure energy. Some say it sings its music at the highest possible pitch so that everyone can hear the scream of its soul. Others, however, say it is simply screaming for no apparent reason. The truth is still unknown.

698.name: GigaBreakDamemon
698.desc: This unusual Digimon is the result of a DigiXros between a GigaBreakdramon and a Damemon. Being the fusion of a Digimon known for being the most destructive, and a Digimon born from trash data, it is uncertain if GigaBreakDamemon still possesses its former destructive power. Some say it seems to be totally weak, but the truth is still to be discovered. Even in this larger and more imposing form, its favorite phrase is still ''No good, no good!'' and it secretly keeps its unfortunate habit of criticizing everyone around it.

699.name: PataSparrowmon*
699.desc: This unusual Digimon is the result of a DigiXros between a Patamon and a Sparrowmon. Despite its small size, this Digimon soars with divine precision across the skies, combining its inherited holy powers with unmatched maneuverability. Its movements reflect not only its mood but also its deep sense of justice.##*Speculative name. This Digimon has no known official name.

700.name: OgreMervamon*
700.desc: A Digimon that defies all expectations. The result of the unlikely DigiXros between Ogremon and Mervamon. The disconcerting combination of its youthful appearance and monstrous head creates a presence that oscillates between the absurd and the exotic. Many Digimon hesitate to face it. Not out of fear, but because of the strangeness and aura of imbalance that it emanates.#*Speculative name. This Digimon has no known official name.

701.name: BloomLordmon
701.desc: A Pixie Digimon clad in vegetal armor, BloomLordmon is a kind-hearted knight that fights to protect nature. The flowers on its shoulders allow it to absorb energy from sunlight, which it stores for use in battle. When its energy stores are full, BloomLordmon's powers are said to rival those of the Royal Knights'. What's more, its ability to bring sun to the stormiest of weather means it always has the upper hand when fighting outdoors.

702.name: KoDokugumon
702.desc: A spider-shaped Rookie Digimon that moves in tandem with Dokugumon. KoDokugumon is usually gentle, rolling up into a ball and hanging from tree branches and the like. But when enemies approach, it will drop down from above with its brethren to attack. It can't produce strong poison yet, and so wears gloves that inject strong poison from claws at the tips.

703.name: Troopmon
703.desc: An artificial Digimon created by filling a unique rubber body with energy stolen from other Digimon. Troopmon is like a machine that simply carries out orders with no capacity to act on its own. It is also tireless, immune to pain, unafraid of death, and doesn't require sleep. It is essentially a fighting machine. Troopmon tend to act in groups, and while the combat ability of each individual isn't very high, their sheer numbers when they charge forward in a wave combined with their combat familiarity make them a force to be reckoned with.

704.name: MachLeomon
704.desc: A Lion-type Digimon that closely resembles MadLeomon, though it exhibits several distinct differences such as a much lighter-colored mane and a preference for wielding daggers as their weapon of choice. MachLeomon serves as the commander of a certain evil army and is known for its ruthless leadership and cunning in battle. While it shares the same cruel and savage personality as MadLeomon, MachLeomon's combat tactics emphasize speed and precision over sheer power.

705.name: Apemon
705.desc: A legendary Beast Man Digimon with golden fur. Many sightings of Apemon have been reported in the central Asian region of the Network, but no actual evidence of its existence has yet been found. Since it's extremely rare and reportedly excels at defeating malicious computer viruses, some humans consider it to be a mythical Digimon. It is also said to travel at extremely high speed within the Network by riding on some sort of cloud or puff of smoke.

706.name: MadLeomon (Final Mode)
706.desc: A colossal Beast Man Digimon that is the ultimate form of MadLeomon, becoming the pinnacle of berserk evolution. While its massive frame suggests brute force alone, it defies expectations with astonishing speed and feral agility. Compared to its prior forms, its savage instincts have grown even more uncontrollable, turning it into a living embodiment of destruction.

707.name: MadLeomon (Orochi Mode)
707.desc: A Demon Beast Digimon born from the DigiXros of a MadLeomon and an Orochimon, resulting in a massive beast with snake heads for limbs and tail. It is said that this Digimon has first appeared when a desperate MadLeomon was defeated in battle by its enemies and was forced to absorb data from an Orochimon in order to overcome those who defeated it. However, it is not known whether it succeeded or not.

709.name: Mush-Upped MachLeomon
709.desc: A Beast Digimon that was deceived into consuming a forbidden hallucinogenic mushroom. Though this granted it immense power, said mushroom also infected its data, twisting its mind and driving it into madness. This corrupted form emits a sickly sweet stench, described by others as ''rotten garbage''. With its sanity devoured by the fungus, it has become a tragic puppet, doomed to serve the ambitions of its masters until the last scrap of its data is consumed.

710.name: MadLeomon: Armed Mode
710.desc: A rare, corrupted subspecies of MadLeomon: Armed Mode whose body has turned a chilling blue, said to be the result of extensive self-inflicted mechanical modifications that gradually corroded its data. While it shares many traits with its standard counterpart, this version is noticeably more aggressive and volatile, its corrupted enhancements pushing it to more reckless and destructive behavior. It is feared even among Virus Digimon for its unpredictable outbursts and unrelenting thirst for combat.

711.name: BigSnowmon
711.desc: A gigantic Digimon, made of what appears to be snow, that bears the alias of ''Great Yeti''. Odd little mouths can be seen on its back, but their true function is unknown. Its origin is surrounded in mystery, but it seems to be tied to a long lost Chinese Digital World called ''Shenzou'', that can be accessed by the Jiuzhaigou Forest.

712.name: Keemon
712.desc: A Slime Digimon with a perpetual glower that always seems to be glaring at something. Though quite young, Keemon hates buddying up with others, and lives its life in hiding. It prefers poking its nose into the affairs of others from its hiding place, using Pushū to pester them with a paint-laden water cannon fired from its mouth.

713.name: Yarmon
713.desc: A Lesser Digimon Digivolved from Keemon. It has turned into quite the contrarian as Yaamon. When it stumbles upon Digimon playing happily, it spits a Paint Splash from its mouth to cover them in ink. Yarmon enjoys seeing how Digimon are stunned by this act.

714.name: Tailmon
714.desc: It has a very healthy curiosity, so it loves pranks. Unlike most Tailmon, this one does not possess a Holy Ring. This appears to be the reason why this Digimon possesses only a fraction of the power it would normally have. In order to defend itself, it wears long claws copied from SaberLeomon's data.

715.name: Mikemon
715.desc: A Beast Digimon resembling a calico cat. Latent Nyaromon data in Mikemon's Rookie form manifests itself when the Digimon achieves Champion form. Mikemon is not a Holy Beast Digimon, however, and it lacks a Holy Ring. A clever Digimon, it is normally quiet and docile. In battle, however, it toys with foes using agile movements and special melee techniques.

716.name: Allomon
716.desc: A Dinosaur Digimon that resides in a strange land, created by a powerful Warrior Digimon of Norse mythology. It displays even higher levels of ferocity than a regular Allomon, and because of this, it is seen forming smaller hunting groups, consisting of only two or three individuals. It is not known for certain whether this Digimon exists outside of the reality created by said Warrior Digimon.

717.name: Toucanmon
717.desc: A Toucanmon that came from a long lost digital server that has recently reappeared. Even though its shell seems worn by time, its beak has clearly more vivid colors. It is unclear whether the color variations in this Digimon are caused by different rendering settings, or if it is a different species.

718.name: Shurimon
718.desc: A Mutant Digimon that has the attribute of Plant. This dark colored variant is often seen in commanding positions, serving as both a warrior and an adviser. It is uncertain if this Digimon has any relation to the Digimental of Sincerity.

719.name: Curimon
719.desc: An In-Training Digimon characterized by its single horn and the large frill extending from the top of its head. Curimon is a highly active Digimon, and will bounce around in its Digi-Egg before even being born. Once it hatches, it's always on the move, like a little ball of energy. Since its horn and its frill are still soft and undeveloped, it can't use them in battle, but they're still useful when it comes to maintaining its balance and helping it bounce back from crashing into things.

720.name: Gurimon
720.desc: An In-Training Digimon with two horns on its forehead that grew from Curimon. Gurimon bounds around in search of big, sturdy-looking boulders. When it finds one, it uses its signature move Prickly Attack to crash into the stone with its horns. Should the boulder withstand the attack, Gurimon will be overjoyed, running around in a sudden burst of energy in hopes of growing even stronger.

721.name: Gammamon
721.desc: An extremely rare, young white Ceratopsian Digimon that was recently discovered. Gammamon's Digivolution is said to be related to a digital signal that came from somewhere outside our galaxy. The two sturdy horns growing from its head are weapons for both attack and defense. Gammamon uses the small wings on its back to float, allowing it to fly a little. It rarely shows emotion, but it seems to grow friendly over time once it establishes an emotional bond.

722.name: BetelGammamon
722.desc: The matured form of Gammamon, its body turned red from the flames of its burning soul. BetelGammamon is more agile, and boasts improved speed and power in close combat. The strength of its attacks multiplies in accordance with the swelling of its emotions.

723.name: WezenGammamon
723.desc: The Champion form of Gammamon, a quadruped with a magnanimous heart and imposing mentality. Firearms pepper WezenGammamon's body; it shoots the two horns on its head as long-range artillery, the horn on its nose as an anti-aircraft gun, and four small autocannons on its legs. Its movement speed is usually slow.

724.name: KausGammamon
724.desc: The matured form of Gammamon, its body turned blue from the tranquility of its serene soul. KausGammamon spreads the membranes on its arms to float like a glider. It will fly far distances from high elevations, using the jets on its knees to raise its elevation once during its flight. It is calm and collected at all times, and fights while reading its opponent's movements.

725.name: GulusGammamon
725.desc: The evil heart hidden within Gammamon was unleashed, Digivolving it into a violent Digimon. GulusGammamon rejects outside interference and thinks of nothing but battle. When it gets its hands on the opponent in front of it, it will continue its assault until their life is extinguished. Its battles are brutal, and even if its limbs are crushed, it still continues attacking without concern.

726.name: Canoweissmon
726.desc: A Sky Dragon Digimon with large, majestic wings turned a pure white by the ferocity of the roaring flames in its heart. Canoweissmon prefers honorable battles, be they in power or in speed. Its delight in combat increases the fiercer the battle becomes. However, Canoweissmon tolerates no acts of duplicity and will oppose them by enforcing its sense of righteousness. When Canoweissmon releases all of its power, its entire body shines with white-hot light so intense that it can be perceived in other dimensions.

727.name: Regulusmon
727.desc: An Evil Dragon Digimon that plots to rule through rage and fear. As an Ultimate-level Digimon, Regulusmon boasts power reminiscent of Megidramon of the famed Four Great Dragons, and its advent alone spells disaster. Its body is the source of the ''GRB'' (Gulus Realm Burst) contagion, and it is said that Digimon infected by the GRB factor undergo a twisted change in personality and run amok.

728.name: Siriusmon
728.desc: A Mega Dragon Man Digimon belonging to the righteous order called the Virus Busters. Wielding the Sylvia, twin cannons equipped on its arms, Siriusmon crashes in like a shooting star to defeat its enemies after hearing a voice calling for help from far, far, away or sensing evil. However, Siriusmon's kind heart is such that it is willing to put its weapons down and open its heart to an opponent in the middle of battle if it senses the possibility of reforming them.

729.name: Arcturusmon
729.desc: A mysterious Digimon that supposedly Digivolves via evil, dark energy concentrated to extreme levels. During research into Digimon that can secrete the so-called GRB Contagion, simulations of injecting enormous amounts of the contagion into such a Digimon resulted in this ''theoretically'' possible Digivolution. The simulation was repeated hundreds of times, and all resulted in this Digimon. Researchers theorize that, under suitable conditions, Arcturusmon could actually manifest in the Digital World.

730.name: Punkmon
730.desc: A Digimon that Digivolved by absorbing data about the music and fashion of punk rock culture. It is aggressive and rebellious in nature, as if it were the personification of punk rock anarchy. Rarely listening to what others say, Punkmon is an anarchist at heart who hates being ordered around and following others. Fond of fighting with flair, it will do anything to bring excitement to the battlefield, even if it means taking an attack on purpose to show off its opponent's moves.

731.name: BlackGuilmon
731.desc: A Digimon with a ferocious personality characteristic of carnivorous beasts. It is at the same level as Guilmon in terms of parameters. The wild nature of a Virus attribute Digimon shows more strongly in it compared to Guilmon.

732.name: BlackGrowmon
732.desc: A Dark Dragon Digimon known as the ''Jet-Black Dark Dragon''. Basically the same species as Growlmon, BlackGrowlmon has a stronger Virus type disposition, and is said to be Growlmon's original form. Unlike a Growlmon raised by a Tamer, it should be considered almost entirely feral. Just like Growlmon, its roar is mighty enough to shake the ground, and BlackGrowlmon uses it as an aggressive display to intimidate the enemy before battle.

733.name: Growmon (Orange)
733.desc: A Growlmon that's turned orange as a result of becoming a Data type. Although Growlmon (Orange) tends to be more calmer than its Virus type counterpart, it is quick to fly into a rage if anything goes wrong.

734.name: Loudmon
734.desc: A Digimon that Digivolved by absorbing data from various types of musical equipment and violent rock music. The armor covering its body is equipped with various functions, such as speakers that amplify the sound taken in from its chest microphone, and an effector that alters its voice. Its main speakers deploy during battle, allowing it to sing at an extremely high volume. As they will be exposed to the loud and raucous noise emanating from its body, any who oppose Loudmon are unable to perform at their best.

735.name: BlackMegaloGrowmon
735.desc: BlackWarGrowlmon is an Ultimate Android Digimon that Digivolved from BlackGrowlmon. Like BlackGrowlmon, BlackWarGrowlmon fiercely expresses its nature as a Virus type, and it's also known as the Black Destroyer Dragon. The upper half of its body is made of super-metal Chrome Digizoid, and it can fly thanks to the two vernier thrusters on its shoulders. It also has a freely extensible cord-like object that extends from its back which can double as a weapon to pierce foes.

736.name: MegaloGrowmon (Orange)
736.desc: WarGrowlmon (Orange) is an Android Digimon that Digivolved from the Data type of Growlmon. Armored in super-metal Chrome Digizoid, it also has anti-air capabilities thanks to its two vernier thrusters.

737.name: HeavyMetaldramon
737.desc: A Digimon that Digivolved into the form of an intimidating dragon by absorbing heavy metal culture. It thinks of its battles as a ''show'' and has a competitive nature that makes it seek out powerful opponents that can further excite an audience. It may even venture into the Dark Area in search of more thrilling battles, which is rife with evil creatures. HeavyMetaldramon's body is covered in Black Digizoid that clangs with the sound of metal against metal whenever it moves, and its guitar-shaped wings emit a deafening roar.

738.name: Ballistamon
738.desc: A heavyweight Digimon with a thick metal shell and overwhelming power. It appears belligerent at first glance, but Ballistamon's gentle personality favors peace over conflict, and it never attacks of its own accord. Even so, if a fight breaks out it becomes a champion of unparalleled power, swinging around its strong arms to eradicate foes. Its heavy armor and incredible power offer high potential for both offense and defense.

739.name: Shoutmon X2
739.desc: Ballistamon's Enhanced Armor Mode excels in defense. By housing another Digimon inside of it, it confers that Digimon power and defense several times greater than usual. Fusing the potential of both Digimon gives it access to many powerful special moves. Shoutmon X2's wide range of special moves lets it handle combat against single opponents or groups, including melee attacks, beam attacks, and live ammunition. These moves draw out an ample amount of Ballistamon's latent ability.

740.name: Pucchiemon
740.desc: An Armor Pixie Digimon that has Digivolved with the Digimental of Kindness. Capricious by nature, Pucchiemon loves having its head rubbed as much as it enjoys gossiping, and often sings when in a good mood. It hates having its tail touched, however; if you try to force it, Pucchiemon's mood will sour and it won't listen to a word you say. While hardly strong, it possesses the mysterious ability to calm its opponents.

741.name: Pucchiemon (Green)
741.desc: An Armor Pixie Digimon that has Digivolved with the Digimental of Kindness. Capricious by nature, Pucchiemon (Green) loves having its head rubbed as much as it enjoys gossiping, and often sings when in a good mood. It hates having its tail touched, however, and if you try to force it, this Digimon's mood will sour and it won't listen to a word you say. This green variant of Pucchiemon is quite rare, so it is very valuable.

742.name: BlackGalgomon
742.desc: BlackGalgomon is a type of Galgomon that excels at hiding in shadows and ambushing foes. Specializing in hand-to-hand combat, it also uses superior fighting techniques and has a higher degree of combat prowess than Gargomon. It has a remarkably cool personality, and is known for finishing its opponents with unerring strikes. Also, parts of its body have been coated in Black Digitron, providing it with increased defensive capabilities.

743.name: BlackRapidmon
743.desc: BlackRapidmon is a black version of Rapidmon that has become capable of fighting at night after ingesting Black Digitron. While it's lost some of its speed, it's also gained the ability to move without making a sound. Still capable of tracking enemies with its radar ears, BlackRapidmon excels at fighting in the dark, making it exceptionally difficult to defeat in a battle at night.

744.name: BlackSaintGalgomon
744.desc: A type of MegaGargomon equipped with a massive amount of weapons to assault enemy territory. BlackSaintGargomon lacks speed, but uses the heat-based ordnance all over its body to counter attacks from all directions without taking a single step.

745.name: Chibickmon
745.desc: A highly social Digimon that's always ready to give its all. Chibickmon loves to imitate others and lend a helping hand.
