If there's a task you're trying to accomplish, large numbers of them may suddenly show up out of nowhere to help you. Since they generally don't understand the purpose of any given task, however, what they consider helpful may be no more than a nuisance. To make matters worse, if you ignore them or hurt their feelings they're quick to burst into tears, only adding to the distraction.

746.name: Starmon
746.desc: Starmon has a cheerful and attention-seeking personality, and is an extraordinary optimist to boot. It never gets depressed, and even its rare moments of discouragement are filled with thoughts of how cool it looks when it's down. Other Digimon view Starmon as silly because of this trait, but it doesn't mind in the least.

747.name: Starmons
747.desc: ''Starmons'' is a unit comprised of a Starmon flanked by several Pickmon. The entire squad moves to the beat of the leader Starmon's drum. The leader's decisions are absolute, and the subordinate Pickmon move with perfect coordination in accordance to Starmon's commands. This harsh pecking order allows it to use group attacks like Meteor Shower and Wish Upon A Star, both of which require complex movements.

748.name: ShootingStarmon
748.desc: ShootingStarmon is the Jogress form of a Starmon and a group of Pickmon. It is the result of several Pickmon gathering around a Starmon and, in an effort of shared will, propelling that Starmon to the level of a Super Major Digimon.

749.name: Vikemon
749.desc: A Mega Beast Man Digimon that rules over the icy peaks of the highest mountains. It is said that this subspecies of Vikemon inhabits the ''Snow Mountain'', a frozen region located in the North Sector of a certain Server from the Digital World. Although it has been sighted in Snow Mountain, apart from its combat techniques, which are more focused on raw power, much about this Digimon still remains a mystery.

750.name: Vegiemon
750.desc: A Carnivorous Plant Digimon with long vines and a gaping maw. This fiendish brute emits a sweet smell from its mouth to lure in smaller Digimon, then ensnares them with its long, tentacle-like vines. Still, Vegiemon lacks any offensive power, making it no match for large-scale Digimon. When Vegiemon grows, it will flower and bear fruit.

751.name: GiganticPumpkinmon
751.desc: An enormous Pumpkinmon that rides a giant pumpkin, making it appear even larger. This Digimon is said to appear during Halloween to enjoy the festivities. Despite its playful appearance, it is a powerful attacker that should not be underestimated. However, despite all the strength this Digimon possesses, it prefers to spend its time enjoying Halloween rather than fighting.

752.name: NoblePumpkinmon
752.desc: The Mega form of Pumpkinmon, now dressed in more gentlemanly attire. NoblePumpkinmon has stayed true to the path of mediation, walking the fine line between justice and evil. Its only goal is to bring a smile to the face of each and every Digimon. With its cheerful personality and occasionally playful behavior, other Digimon are quick to open up to it, and no Digimon is ever cruel to NoblePumpkinmon. The staff in its hand, the Assam Ring Jack, can create pumpkin-based dishes delicious enough to satisfy anyone.

753.name: Soulmon
753.desc: A Ghost Digimon made up of cursed virus programs. This version of Bakemon incorporated the data of magicians that appear in fantasy, and its black hat bolsters its magic power. This makes its curse and magic attacks devastatingly strong.

754.name: Witchmon
754.desc: A Digimon resembling a witch, who pursued its rival Wizardmon from Witchelny, the Digital World of another dimension. Witchmon mastered wind and water magic (advanced programming languages) in its hometown of Witchelny, but it pursued Wizardmon to the Digital World and trains vigorously in order to get a leg up on a rival who aims to become a great sage. It has a bit of a cruel streak, more than a bit of pride, and loathes both convention and established routines.

755.name: Rockmon
755.desc: A Digimon whose body is mostly made up of rock data. It lacks emotion, and acts as ordered. On certain occasion, a bulkier version of Rockmon will be born when it is created by unifying data fragments from important places in the Digital World, such as the Tree of Knowledge.

756.name: Ex-Tyranomon
756.desc: A Puppet Digimon that hides inside a stuffed animal shaped like Tyranomon. Why exactly this mysterious Digimon chose a stuffed Tyranomon is unclear, but it probably just hid inside whatever stuffed animal was nearby. Whatever the explanation, this stuffed Tyranomon has all the offensive and defensive power of Monzaemon, meaning no ordinary Digimon can stand up to it. However, it's also similar to Monzaemon in that it's little more than a doorstop without someone to control it.

757.name: Dot Falcomon
757.desc: A special Falcomon that emerged from a keychain game. Although it is without a doubt a subspecies of Falcomon, its potential abilities are unknown.

758.name: Dot Agumon
758.desc: A special Agumon that emerged from a keychain game. Although it is without a doubt a subspecies of Agumon, its potential abilities are unknown.

759.name: QueenBeemon
759.desc: An ambitious Android Digimon that rules over the ''Royal Base'' as its queen and is always seeking to expand the size and scope of its base. With high prowess in both science and engineering, it was responsible for the design and development of the Royal Base. It can manage defensive positioning and combat formations all by itself. On the other hand, it is inferior to TigerVespamon in regards to its capabilities in single combat. That difference is compensated for by its secret weapon, the Royal Throne.

760.name: Chicchimon
760.desc: A small Digimon which looks like a chick. It's still physically weak and isn't suitable for an actual fight, but even though it's a Baby II Digimon, we can see how it'll turn out to be after evolving.

761.name: Hyokomon
761.desc: A Chick Digimon that evolved via data related to samurai. It works hard training day and night, developing secret fencing in order to master swordsmanship. Although it shows confidence in its sword abilities, it still lacks merit. It is said that once Hyokomon has undergone repeated sword training and is able to break out of its shell, it will be the moment of its next evolution.

762.name: Buraimon
762.desc: A Bird Man Digimon that evolved after continuous sword training. At the end of its training, it acquired enough skill to freely wield two swords. It is on a training pilgrimage, wandering across the Digital World while working as a bodyguard, relying on its honed sword abilities. It is rumored to take any job for a reward, and is often treated as an outlaw. However, it actually has a kind nature that never forgets its spirit of helping the weak, and will never take jobs that torment the weak.

763.name: Butenmon
763.desc: A God Man Digimon clad in crimson armor, wielding a greatsword, it evolves from Digimon who have honed their sword abilities through repeated battles. Despite being an Ultimate, it is an expert who has already mastered swordsmanship. Possessing sword techniques that even feel beautiful and such incredible strength that is said to shatter mountains, the way it runs across the battlefield with its greatsword in hand is truly a statement for someone worth a thousand warriors.

764.name: Chronomon: Holy Mode
764.desc: A God Man Digimon that is also said to be a materialization of the system that governs time. The flow of time in the Digital World is truly vague, and disturbances in space-time occasionally occur due to conflicts between powerful Digimon or cataclysms. It is Chronomon who appears on those occasions, tasked with restoring space-time. Once it restores space-time, the fact that it manifested also disappears along with the space-time disturbance, so no one has seen Chronomon.

765.name: Chronomon: Destroy Mode
765.desc: The berserk form of Chronomon. It is a legendary monster that is said to have abandoned its role of preserving the peace of space-time, and risen in revolt against the system that governs time. While it was restoring space-time, the various forms of malice in the Digital World flowed into Chronomon all at once, corroding it like a virus, and causing it to run wild. By abusing the power of time that Chronomon originally possessed, it hacks into memories engraved into the Digital World and then goes on a rampage.

766.name: Rurimon
766.desc: A special Digimon that emerged as a reward in a certain campaign. Even though it has many similarities with Agumon, its potential abilities are unknown.

767.name: Dracomon
767.desc: A pure-blooded Dragon Digimon that seems to be even older than its regular counterpart. This greenish Dracomon was found very deep in the net and it is origin is unclear. It possesses physical ability to a degree that could not be imagined from its small build.

768.name: Parallelmon
768.desc: A Mutant Digimon capable of freely traveling to and from Digital Worlds of other dimensions. Its objective shrouded in mystery, this fiendish existence devours the data of Digimon that inhabit the worlds it travels to. Parallelmon emerges out of nowhere like a phantom, and the great chaos and confusion it wreaks has led research teams to classify its appearance as a natural disaster.

769.name: Hydramon
769.desc: A gigantic Vegetation Digimon that primarily settles in swamps. Hydramon excretes a deadly poison from every part of its body, which it mercilessly uses on prey to liquefy and then eat it. It also spews out large amounts of the same toxic substance from its chest, turning the earth into swampland, extending its territory. Such swamps warp the surrounding flora and fauna, so be on the lookout for Hydramon if you run across an area with mutated and twisted plant life.

770.name: Sangloupmon
770.desc: A noble-minded, bloodsucking wolf Digimon. Sangloupmon is a considerably old species of Digimon said to have survived since the dawn of the Digital World. Digimon who have their blood sucked by Sangloupmon have all the information drained from their DigiCores, making them unable to maintain vital activity and ending their life. Sangloupmon disassembles its own data into packets and sends them across the Net, letting it teleport to other locations.

771.name: Matadrmon
771.desc: A bloodsucking martial artist Digimon that performs a magnificent dance. Born from a certain museum's folk dance database, Matadrmon is a master of the unique Bulldog dance. Its fluttering garments serve to deceive its foes, and it attacks those who let their guard down with the countless rapiers hidden in the folds of its sleeves. Matadrmon sustains itself by sucking Digimon blood, but not just any will do. It wanders from land to land in search of strong Digimon to feed upon.

772.name: GrandDracumon
772.desc: GrandDracumon is a Dark Beast Digimon known as the king of all vampire Digimon. It has long maintained its own castle in the Dark Area, and is said to boast such overwhelming power that not even the Seven Great Demon Lords dare to interfere with it. Between its gentlemanly demeanor and the magical glamor in its voice, GrandDracumon can be devilishly charming, and there are numerous tales of Angel Digimon sent to destroy it that it then lured to the dark side.

773.name: Commandramon
773.desc: An infantry Digimon of the D-Brigade. This mechanized brigade is a special forces unit composed of Dragon Cyborg Digimon, committed to missions kept secret from the public at all costs. Commandramon's skin has been modified with a special texture that detects surrounding colors in real time, allowing it to display all sorts of camouflage. Thus, most of Commandramon's targets end up in the ground without realizing it exists.

774.name: Hi-Commandramon
774.desc: A heavy infantry Digimon of the D-Brigade. It is said that many of the 100 Commandramon who don't pass the special screening exam Selection-D will Digivolve into Hi-Commandramon. Its main role is to act as a shield, protecting the Commandramon assault troops with its massive build and protective armor. Like Commandramon, its skin has been modified with a special texture that detects and displays surrounding colors in real time.

775.name: Duftmon: Leopard Mode
775.desc: A Holy Knight Digimon that is acknowledged even by the other Royal Knights as their foremost strategist. This Leopard Mode is the form Duftmon takes when entering the battlefield. In this form, Duftmon can attack with high-speed ground and air attacks.

776.name: Dominimon
776.desc: Dominimon does not answer in any way to the angelic chain of command, and instead acts on its own. A rare type that suddenly manifests via mutation when the balance between the light and darkness of the Digital World is disrupted, Dominimon is almost never sighted. Valuing all life as a collective over any single entity, Dominimon does not consider its own life especially important. In order to escape a tricky situation, it will perform a death-defying attack without hesitation.

778.name: Chaos Lord
778.desc: A unique species of Chaosdramon said to be the leader of an organization called Blood Knights. Its existence is surrounded in mystery and its exact location can only be found by those who are able to defeat the Three Chaos Generals and collect their Chaos Rings. It claims to be the most powerful Digimon, and it believes that all living beings strive to reach the peak of evolution by winning multiple battles.

779.name: Sheepmon
779.desc: An Armor Mammal Digimon that has Digivolved with the Digi-Egg of Hope. Sheepmon's body is covered in wool of the finest quality. It also moves very sluggishly. Just observing a flock of these Digimon moving will put anyone to sleep. The booster/bazooka unit on its back is called a Wool Ball Booster. This equipment reproduces the low-speed movement characteristic of Sheepmon.

780.name: Duskmon
780.desc: A Digimon with power over darkness that bears the might of the Ten Legendary Warriors. Duskmon is the embodiment of an immense dark energy formed from the vengeful will of various types of extinct Digimon as well as Forbidden Data on the Net. Just as dark energy exists as the counterpart of the holy force of light, Duskmon is the antithesis of those who possess holy power. Unmatched in contests of swordsmanship, Duskmon never hesitates to resort to underhanded attacks.

781.name: Sealsdramon
781.desc: It is said that only a Commandramon that passes the Selection-D exam is capable of Digivolving into Sealsdramon. This is no mean feat, as the Selection-D exam is a special test that involves screening 100 Commandramon until only one remains. Sealsdramon can move at speeds practically impossible to follow with the naked eye, and is strong enough to finish off its targets using only hand-to-hand combat, never relying on guns or camouflage techniques. Most of its missions consist of assassinations.

782.name: Pusumon
782.desc: Pusumon is a Slime Digimon covered in fur as soft as cotton. Only the yellow hairs sticking out of its forehead are even somewhat hard. It gets anxious if it doesn't have its pacifier with it at all times, and will cry loudly and constantly if its binky ever goes missing. When threatened, Pusumon will take a deep breath to puff itself up, then blow out all that air to send its pacifier flying in an attempt to intimidate foes.

783.name: Pusurimon
783.desc: A quadrupedal Lesser Digimon with yellow spikes growing from its back. Pusurimon is always running around, full of energy. Every now and then it will appear to stop dead in its tracks, but this is just due to it falling asleep.

784.name: Herissmon
784.desc: Herissmon is a Digimon brimming with curiosity, and will often focus on whatever has just caught its interest to the exclusion of everything else. Despite this, it's also extremely cautious, and if it ever feels threatened it will extend its hard, needle-like quills and curl up into a ball until the danger has passed. Once it's opened up to someone, though, it is quick to become close friends with them, and will happily show off its favorite treasures, which it keeps hidden among its quills.

785.name: Filmon
785.desc: A Beast Man Digimon with countless large quills growing from its body. Filmon's red claws can pierce through anything, and its yellow quills pour energy into whatever they stab. It gathers up comfortable nest materials while seeking out its favorite foods in a laid-back manner.

786.name: Stiffilmon
786.desc: Only a small number of Filmon can temper their quills to their limits, achieving this Ultimate form. The quills all over Stefilmon are said to rival Red Digizoid in their sturdiness, acting as both a shield around its body and pikes boasting unparalleled attack strengths. The Hurricane Knuckles on its arms are its pride and joy, highly condensing its shed fur to form weapons. It trains diligently, dreaming of the day it can trade blows with its perceived rival, WereGarurumon.

787.name: Rasenmon
787.desc: Rasenmon's true form, achieved by accepting its negative emotions without fear and regaining the courage to believe in itself. Severing the shackles of negativity, Rasenmon has gained full control of its rampaging power in this form, and its brutal disposition has calmed into a kind, gentle nature. In battle, it can accumulate more power by absorbing the emotions of its allies as energy, and only makes use of said power for actions it believes are just.

788.name: Rasenmon: Fury Mode
788.desc: A brutal, nine-tailed Mega Digimon that took in large quantities of negative emotion data when it Digivolved from its Ultimate form, losing the ability to control its dark power. Once it finished Digivolving, Rasenmon gave itself over to the rampaging power of darkness, becoming an avatar of destruction that impulsively devastates the surrounding area. Its brutal personality is the result of the destructive impulses born from painful conflict, as it fears and rejects the negative emotions swirling within itself.

789.name: Sakuyamon: Miko Mode
789.desc: This is the form Sakuyamon takes on when performing Shinto rituals in accordance with the will of the gods. Sakuyamon rarely fights while in Miko Mode, but it is more skilled in warding off evil in this form.

790.name: Kuzuhamon: Miko Mode
790.desc: Kuzuhamon: Miko Mode is the form Kuzuhamon takes on when performing Shinto rituals in accordance with the will of the gods. Kuzuhamon rarely fights while in Miko Mode, but it is more skilled in warding off evil in this form.

791.name: Dorulumon
791.desc: A Beast Digimon with a strong spirit of chivalry. Dorulumon can mostly be found in rocky, mountainous terrain, where it typically acts independently rather than in groups. The drill on its head is made of its own hardened hair, and its Drill Buster attack, by which it spins this drill at high speed before shooting it at an enemy, never misses. It specializes in hit-and-run tactics, running around at high speed to flush out and then attack enemies before moving out of reach.

792.name: Tobucatmon
792.desc: A cat-shaped Puppet Digimon that flies around the Net Ocean. TobuCatmon has a wild disposition and a love of the sea. The F-14 mark engraved on its body proves this Digimon is a fighter, despite its appearance. A mere 1% of its brethren are referred to as ''Cat Gun'', and are respected as powerful warriors. It can fold its wings to fly at high speeds, but has the habit of flashing the claws on its right leg when turning right, and the claws on its left leg when turning left; thus, the enemy can sometimes read its movements.

793.name: Bastemon
793.desc: A Beast Man Digimon sometimes referred to as the goddess of cats. With an ostentatious but sly personality, Bastemon excels at using the many gems that adorn its body and the alluring flash of its eyes to beguile and then manipulate its foes. It can charm most of the creatures it meets, wrapping them around its little finger. Bastemon's graceful movements are a testament to its exceptional agility, but despite its slender frame it's also quite strong, and the claws on its hands can slice through large boulders.

794.name: Bastemon
794.desc: Although the differences are not many compared to its regular counterpart, this Bastemon possesses extreme physical strength, capable of facing even Mega-level opponents. It uses its Helter Skelter ability to devolve any high-level Digimon in order to gain an advantage in battle. It is known that this subspecies of Bastemon lives on a server in the Digital World known as the Asuka Server, however it is uncertain where it can be found. All that is known is that some individuals are said to partner up with strong Tamers.

795.name: Fusamon
795.desc: A Slime Digimon with soft fur all over its body. Highly curious in nature, this Digimon loves to move around. However, it gets tired very easily, and spends most of its time asleep. When danger draws near, they let out Puppy Noise, a high-pitched warning cry.

796.name: Bowmon
796.desc: A Lesser Digimon with soft fur all over its body. It is curious about everything it sees, and has a habit of sniffing whatever has captured its interest. Although a very active Digimon, it often falls over when running due to its short legs. It is unable to ascend or descend a difference in elevation greater than the length of its legs, and has to roll itself around to move on surfaces with frequent variation in height.

797.name: Loogamon
797.desc: A Dark Beast Digimon presumed to be an experimental ''Prototype Digimon'' from before Digimon were discovered due to the old-fashioned interface on its forehead. It is said that the deepest part of its DigiCore contains data from the warg of real-world mythology, which can be seen in its capacity for rage beyond that of a typical Rookie. Those who are deceived by its puppylike appearance and approach it without proper caution may find themselves on the receiving end of a vicious attack.

798.name: Loogarmon
798.desc: A Dark Beast Digimon with a body that generates enormous amounts of magic. The amount of magic it produces is so great that it constantly releases excess magic in the form of flames that pour out of its mouth. These flames are so powerful that Loogarmon can turn its surroundings to ash with a single roar. As the flames are born of magic, they burn for a long time. Those who fall victim to its burn are dealt a greater injury than they may have expected.

799.name: Soloogarmon
799.desc: A Digimon that has succeeded in controlling the sinister magic data of a mythological warg that lay dormant in the deepest part of its Digicore. Program code written in a special language lines the inside of the armor covering its body. This suppresses its tremendous amount of magical power, which is converted into a tempest of flames, as if it were sealed magic. Soloogarmon can control the magical flames at will by manipulating the program code, using them to perform many different actions.

800.name: Helloogarmon
800.desc: A Digimon in a chaotic state that has been inundated with an enormous amount of magical power. The sinister magic data of a mythological warg that lay dormant in the deepest part of its Digicore has been set free by the interface on its forehead. This vast amount of magical power is converted into flames which spew forth endlessly. The super-hot magical flames have burned their way through Helloogarmon, to the point that nearly its entire body has been replaced by fire.

801.name: Fenriloogamon
801.desc: An imaginary Digimon created from the daydream of a DigiCore. It is a Digimon that Digivolved through the interface on its forehead when its creative powers were miraculously unleashed. Perhaps because the DigiCore originally contained data from the warg of real-world mythology, its creation turned out to be an ''ultimate Dark Beast'' clad in silver armor and possessing an inexhaustible supply of magic. It has complete control of the blue magical flames that permeate its body.

803.name: Baihumon
803.desc: One of the Four Sovereign Digimon that defend the Digital World. This protector of the West bears the attribute of steel. Having reigned since the era of myth, Baihumon is legendary like its kin, and its strength is said to rival even that of the gods. Although it is the youngest, Baihumon is still the most powerful of the Four Sovereign Digimon. Its immortality and immense power are supposedly born of its twelve DigiCores. Like the neutral Azulongmon, Baihumon is a being fundamentally devoid of allies.

804.name: Yihumon
804.desc: A Beast Man Digimon that has the ability to control the wind. Yihumon is extremely brutal and cunning, brimming with malice by nature. It resides in Jakeizan, a vast and mountainous area of the continent in the eastern regions of the Digital World. It seldom emerges from those darkest peaks, home to many evil spirits. According to observation data, there is a high chance that this Digimon has existed since the earliest times, when the eastern regions of the Digital World emerged.

805.name: BlackTailmon Uver.
805.desc: The form taken by BlackTailmon after absorbing large amounts of home delivery service data that has flowed into the Digital World over recent years. Its once-malicious personality gone, BlackTailmon Uver. will deliver packages entrusted to it with dedication, no matter what day it is. It is often spotted clinging to the back of its friend Pistmon to make its deliveries. The delivery bag on BlackGatomon Uver.'s back is in tip-top shape at all times, and can only be opened or closed by the Digimon itself.

806.name: HiMugendramon
806.desc: An enhanced form of the strongest Digimon in the Digital World, with its body completely covered in red metal. It is said that this form is achieved after absorbing large amounts of energy. HiMugendramon's attacks possesses immense destructive power, however are slow and cumbersome, taking a while to charge.

807.name: Scorpiomon
807.desc: Scorpiomon is an Insectoid Digimon also known as the Assassin of the Desert. It prefers to remain hidden, sneaking up on its prey from behind to stab them with the poisonous stinger at the end of its tail. Scorpiomon's venom is so deadly that it takes effect faster than a Digimon's nerve data can process, meaning Scorpiomon prey is killed before even realizing they were stabbed. Its ability to kill without ever alerting its prey to its presence is what has earned it the moniker of assassin.

808.name: Yolkmon
808.desc: A Slime Digimon still wearing the shell from its Digi-Egg on its head. It is laid-back in nature and makes a life for itself slipping into the nests of other Digimon. As the Digi-Egg shell acts as camouflage, Yolkmon is hardly ever spotted before it Digivolves.

809.name: Fluffymon
809.desc: A Mini Bird Digimon that goes about its activities while hiding within the luxuriant leaves of the forest trees. Its wings are undeveloped so it cannot yet fly, but it is agile enough to scamper up even vertical tree trunks.

810.name: Pteromon
810.desc: A Bird Dragon Digimon that freely soars through the skies over vast woodlands. The horns on its head are soft organs that play much more of a sensory role than an offensive one. By reading wind currents with these horns, Pteromon can acutely perceive changes in climate. Pteromon is extremely curious about other kinds of creatures, and often thinks of ways to fly alongside and make contact with other Digimon. These include Rookie Digimon like Biyomon and Falcomon, as well as, sometimes, larger Champions and Ultimates.

811.name: Galemon
811.desc: A Bird Dragon Digimon with large wings and distinct, blade-like horns. Its hardened horns, further developed than those of Pteromon, grant Galemon a kind of sixth sense, allowing it to rapidly detect abnormalities in its surroundings through the winds they sense. An intelligent Digimon, Galemon can strike first by utilizing its ability to predict not only environmental changes, but threats such as enemy ambushes and attacks as well.

812.name: GrandGalemon
812.desc: A massive Ultimate Digimon revered as king of the forest. The surface of the armor that covers even GrandGalemon's wings and beak has a magic coating. GrandGalemon possesses the special ability to reflect light and blend into its surroundings, and, despite their enormity, its wings can muffle sounds when flapped.GrandGalemon's large, comb-like protrusion symbolizes its status as king of the forest, and many of the forest's inhabitants are said to bow down at the mere sight of it.

813.name: Zephagamon
813.desc: A Mega Digimon known as the God of Wind, it embodies the data of the winds that blow across the Digital World. Zephagamon primarily dwells within forest regions, bringing with it warm winds that ripen the fruits of the trees. As such, it safeguards not only Digimon, but the environment itself as well. It is said that, in urgent situations, Zephagamon prevents disasters from happening by unleashing massive energy directly from the atmosphere via its exposed DigiCore.

814.name: Ohakadamon
814.desc: A grave in which a Digimon who has passed away was laid to rest. It also acts as the final farewell to a beloved monster before its final departure. There is beauty to be found in the simplicity of its cross-shape.

815.name: XV-mon (Black)
815.desc: A Virus-attribute Mythical Dragon Digimon that manipulates azure lightning to pierce evil. Just as XV-mon is considered the pure breed of V-dramon, this species of XV-mon is speculated to be the pure breed of V-dramon (Black), however there's no evidence to confirm this theory.

816.name: Stingmon (Black)
816.desc: An extremely unusual Insectoid Digimon with a humanoid shape. It is a nimble sky assassin, protected by a super-hard body said to be even harder than regular Stingmon's exoskeleton.

817.name: Otamamon (Red)
817.desc: An Otamamon mutation that acquired the attribute of flames. This attribute is the reason why Otamamon (Red) prefers hot springs instead of cold rivers. Like Otamamon, it loves to sing, and never skips out on vocal training. Its developed forelimbs are strong enough to clamber up rocks, and are powerful assets in battle.

818.name: Tuchidarumon
818.desc: A Digimon composed almost entire of earth data. Tuchidarumon is thought to be a mutant born from a mutation of Yukidarumon. It is friendly by nature and dislikes fighting, but when the chips are down it can demonstrate rarely seen power.

820.name: Shoemon
820.desc: A Puppet Digimon that wears the leather of shoes and the skin of plush toys. If one attempts to touch Shoemon, it will swiftly hop away to escape. It is very cowardly in nature, and, via contact with the ground, acutely senses vibrations to quickly identify outside threats. The incredible grip of Shoemon's sole allows it to traverse the roughest of roads and climb even vertical walls and pillars without issue. Given Shoemon's preference for cleanliness, it dislikes walking in sandy areas or on muddy roads.

821.name: ShoeShoemon
821.desc: An agile Puppet Digimon who traverses as if gliding around on roller skates atop tree canopies. A restless Digimon, it dislikes staying still and is always in motion. ShoeShoemon typically stuffs its food into its cheek pouches, which have a far larger capacity than their appearance suggests. Besides food, it also places important items in these pouches to carry them around. ShoeShoemon also forces items that don't fit into its cheeks between the gaps in its tail or inside the zip pouch on its belly.

822.name: Chaperomon
822.desc: This Ultimate Digimon is an ornamental doll comprising data from fairy tales. Though Chaperomon is humanoid in appearance, its body is more similar to that of a doll's, meaning its joints can also bend in the wrong direction. Despite its demure appearance, Chaperomon actually hunts for sport and is quite hostile in nature. When hunting, Chaperomon stocks its basket with an arsenal of weaponry that it later unloads and utilizes to launch a variety of attacks on its prey.

823.name: Cendrillmon
823.desc: A Mega Digimon born of data from the fairy tale ''Cinderella''. In contrast to its appearance, Cendrillmon inhabits volcanic regions. It lives a quiet life, in solitude and unseen by others, at the ''Ash-Coated Castle'', a base made from volcanic ash. When other Digimon visit its castle, however, it holds battle tournaments it calls ''Balls''. Cendrillmon holds these contests and engages in constant battles in search of a Digimon capable of defeating it, that it might proclaim this Digimon its ''Prince''.

824.name: Shoutmon X3
824.desc: The combination of three Digimon's instincts for conflict is what gave birth to this powerful warrior, Shoutmon X3, also known as Physical Mode. Its mind, body, and techniques are all top notch. Highly maneuverable, it manipulates foes with its acrobatic movements. Despite its delicate appearance, Shoutmon X3 is also good at withstanding shockwave attacks because its flexible joints are able to efficiently absorb and redistribute force. What's more, the V on its chest is a highly versatile weapon.

825.name: MedievalDukemon
825.desc: A Warrior Digimon extolled as the legendary hero of Witchelny, which is the Digital World of another dimension. Ancient Witchelny was on the path to ruin, since its magic (advanced programming language) was still in its infancy and it lacked techniques to protect the land from invasion by outside forces. It is said that MedievalDukemon suddenly appeared and repelled invaders, and that it transcends time to exist to the present day, although the truth is uncertain.

826.name: Pafumon
826.desc: A spirit Digimon with a translucent body. Pafumon's body is downy and light, so it always drifts through the air. It tends to ride the wind to move, traveling quite a distance depending on which breeze it catches. This gentle soul has no love for conflict, but in a pinch Pafumon will use Puff Balloon, opening its mouth wide and sucking up air to inflate to triple its size. While the enemy is taken aback, it will seize the chance to escape by expelling this air.

827.name: Kyaromon
827.desc: A Lesser Digimon with a powerful tail. Inquisitive and curious about everything, Kyaromon tends to rush at anything that piques its interest. Its body is almost completely hollow, with the elasticity of a rubber ball. When it puts power into its Tail Swing attack, it packs enough of a punch to send even Rookie Digimon flying.

828.name: Nyabootmon
828.desc: A Puppet Digimon whose cape flutters in the wind as it wanders gallantly throughout the Digital World. Although Nyabootmon might not seem very dignified due to its pompous speech and flamboyant gestures, it actually possesses a strong sense of justice and never condones any acts of evil. It practically zips through the air with its tall, gravity-manipulating boots as it journeys across the Digital World, and it relies on its trusty sword, the Catnip Rapier, to deal with any troubles it may encounter during its adventures.

829.name: Youkomon
829.desc: Youkomon is a Mysterious Beast Digimon in the shape of a giant blue fox with nine tails. Unlike Kyubimon, Youkomon is feared as a strange beast that brings only destruction and decay. It lacks attack power, but possesses incredible spiritual energy and specializes in spells. The red flames burning on its limbs supposedly allow Youkomon to gallop through the heavens.

830.name: Kyubimon (Silver)
830.desc: A bewitching subspecies of Kyubimon with silver fur who evolved into a Vaccine-attribute Digimon. Although it's less intelligent than Kyubimon, it seems to have excellent speed.

831.name: Doumon
831.desc: A Taoist Digimon that uses all the skills of faith to defeat opponents. Doumon is particularly talented at curses and charms. Like Taomon, Doumon usually resides in the dark, but unlike Taomon, Doumon specializes in death curses and assassination. Doumon can also change charms into familiars known as shikigami.

832.name: Taomon (Silver)
832.desc: A Taomon enrobed in silver clothing and skin. An eerie mage who has awakened to the Vaccine-attribute.

833.name: Soundbirdmon
833.desc: A Bird Digimon with speakers built into its wings. Always alert for danger, Soundbirdmon is normally very quiet, but if it's ever approached by a Digimon it finds suspicious, it will shriek loudly to drive the intruder away.

834.name: Eyesmon: Scatter Mode
834.desc: The scattered form of Eyesmon. Eyesmon: Scatter Mode monitors social networking services streaming high volumes of data, devouring and storing the largest chunks. Although one of these Digimon is weak when alone due to fragmentation, they will reform into a single entity to counterattack in the face of danger.

835.name: Eyesmon
835.desc: A Digimon that can hide in shadow. Eyesmon grows stronger the more data it accumulates, surpassing even Ultimate-level power depending on the amount stored. Its countless eyes capture any and all movements of its enemies.

836.name: Devidramon
836.desc: A demonic beast summoned from the Dark Area by the messenger of darkness Devimon, no Digimon comes close to this creature in terms of sheer wickedness. Devidramon has abnormally developed limbs for a Dramon-species Digimon. Evil incarnate, not an ounce of mercy resides in this creature's heart. Its four eyes burn a deep crimson; those caught in Devidramon's gaze seize up, allowing it to hew them to pieces without resistance.

837.name: Shademon
837.desc: A Digimon without substance, haunting the shadows of both man and Digimon. Shademon drinks the despair of those it possesses, feeding off of them. The amount of despair it consumes determines what kind of atrocious Digimon it will Digivolve into.

12.desc_pt: Uma maçã de cor e propriedade especial. Recupera instantaneamente 1/3 dos PV de seu Digimon.

13.name: Protein
13.desc: Special pills that liven up any Digimon! Fully recovers a Digimon's Energy, however the lower its level, higher the chances of it getting ill.
13.desc_pt: Pílulas especiais que revitalizam qualquer Digimon! Recupera totalmente a energia de seu Digimon, entretanto, quanto menor for seu nível, maiores as chances dele ficar doente.

14.name: DigiAnchovy
14.desc: Common specie of fish found in every body of water of the Digital World. Makes your Digimon a bit full.
14.desc_pt: Espécie comum de peixe encontrada em qualquer corpo de água no Digimundo. Deixa o seu Digimon um pouco satisfeito.

15.name: DigiMedaka
15.desc: A small fish that lives in schools. Makes your Digimon a bit full.
15.desc_pt: Um peixe pequeno que vive em cardume. Deixa o seu Digimon um pouco satisfeito.

16.name: DigiTrout
16.desc: A calm, tough fish that prefers clear streams. Makes your Digimon a bit full.
16.desc_pt: Um peixe calmo, mas durão, que prefere fluxos de água mais limpos. Deixa o seu Digimon um pouco satisfeito.

17.name: DigiSnapper
17.desc: Easy to catch fish. Tastes normal. Makes your Digimon a bit full.
17.desc_pt: Peixe fácil de capturar. Tem gosto de peixe. Deixa o seu Digimon um pouco satisfeito.

18.name: DigiCatfish
18.desc: Large fish, excellent at detecting danger. Makes your Digimon a bit full.
18.desc_pt: Peixe grande, excelente em detectar perigo. Deixa o seu Digimon um pouco satisfeito.

19.name: Short Cake
19.desc: Special cake baked by a certain Digimon. Pretty popular in weddings. Makes your Digimon a bit full.
19.desc_pt: Bolo especial, feito por um certo Digimon. Bastante popular em casamentos. Deixa o seu Digimon um pouco satisfeito.

20.name: Burga Burger
20.desc: Special burger prepared by a certain Digimon. Goes well with fries. Makes your Digimon a bit full.
20.desc_pt: Hambúrguer especial, preparado por um certo Digimon. Vai bem com fritas. Deixa o seu Digimon um pouco satisfeito.

21.name: Digistalk
21.desc: A popular mushroom with digital spores. Makes your Digimon a bit full.
21.desc_pt: Talo de cogumelo com esporos digitais bastante famoso. Deixa o seu Digimon um pouco satisfeito.

22.name: Multi Grape
22.desc: Different grapes growing on a single bunch. Maybe it is a bug? Makes your Digimon a bit full.
22.desc_pt: Uvas diferentes crescendo no mesmo cacho. Será que é um bug? Deixa o seu Digimon um pouco satisfeito.

23.name: Orange Banana
23.desc: A nutrious banana that will make you happy. Makes your Digimon a bit full.
23.desc_pt: AUma banana nutritiva que o fará bastante contente. Deixa o seu Digimon um pouco satisfeito.

24.name: Magma Melon
24.desc: Even growing in warm environments, its interior is very juicy and chill. Makes your Digimon a bit full.
24.desc_pt: Mesmo crescendo em ambientes quentes, seu interior é bastante suculento e refrescante. Deixa o seu Digimon um pouco satisfeito.

25.name: Frozen Orange
25.desc: A chill fruit that tastes like orange ice cream. Makes your Digimon a bit full.
25.desc_pt: Uma fruta gelada que tem gosto de sorvete de laranja. Deixa o seu Digimon um pouco satisfeito.

26.desc_pt: (Equipamento de Caça)#Item de cura. Recupera 100 PV quando usado no Mundo Digital.

29.desc_pt: (Equipamento de Caça)#Item de cura. Recupera 2000 PV quando usado no Mundo Digital.

30.name: Star Sword
30.desc: The saw-shaped blade boasts peerless firmness, so that it shreds the opponent when it cuts through them, inflicting massive damage.##Atk +500 / SpAtk +200
